notes.title: The Shooting Range Update is LIVE - Update 1.2.19
notes.content:
[h1][b]ZERO Sievert — Patch Notes[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/1c155c95e7a9677530c6f6f5661cd707fcbf9350.jpg"][/img][/p][h1][b]WELCOME TO THE RANGE[/b][/h1][p]This patch introduces the long-requested [b]Shooting Range[/b], giving players a dedicated space to test weapons, experiment with builds, and sharpen their combat skills. We’ve also made meaningful improvements to the [b]Prologue[/b], enhancing the early-game experience, along with a range of [b]UI, controller, and quality-of-life updates[/b] to keep ZERO Sievert running smoother than ever. Full details below...[/p][p][/p][h2][b]NEW: SHOOTING RANGE[/b][/h2][p]A long-requested feature is here: the [b]Shooting Range[/b], available immediately in the Bunker — no grind, no unlocks, just straight-up practice.[/p][h3][b]🔧 Where to Find It[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Located in the [b]main Bunker[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Accessible [b]right from the start[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🎯 Purpose-Built Training Ground[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Spawn various enemy types on command — including [b]armoured targets[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Test weapons, builds, and loadouts in [b]safe, controlled conditions[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]📊 Detailed Feedback System[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Live stats[/b]: Damage, recoil, bullet penetration[/p][/*][*][p]Skill & mastery modifiers[/p][/*][*][p]Clean vs. glancing hits[/p][/*][*][p]Perfect for tweaking every bullet and build[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/c6921c3556fa4022014c74eefd7b838f9371d838.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🧠 Sharpen Your Skills[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Range markers for distance practice[/p][/*][*][p]Hone [b]close-quarters[/b] reflexes and [b]long-range[/b] precision[/p][/*][*][p]Great for [b]new players[/b] and [b]min-maxers[/b] alike[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]💬 Built with the Community in Mind[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Your feedback helped shape this[/p][/*][*][p]We can't wait to see your creative builds and meta-breaking combos[/p][/*][*][p]Consider it your new lab for destruction[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]PROLOGUE IMPROVEMENTS AND CHANGES[/b][/h2][p]We’ve made the Prologue experience smoother and more focused on learning:[/p][list][*][p]No radiation in the Prologue[/p][/*][*][p]Guns no longer jam during the Prologue[/p][/*][*][p]Time does not pass, so you can learn at your own pace[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced loot in containers and bodies — less hoarding, more exploring[/p][/*][*][p]Removed some static chests to reduce clutter and streamline flow[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]OTHER IMPROVEMENTS & TWEAKS[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Quest text and objectives now appear on the same screen[/p][/*][*][p]Base module crafting blocked unless the previous level is installed[/p][/*][*][p]New dialogue option with the Barman if you have the Prologue letter — he'll hand you 10,000 roubles[/p][/*][*][p]Quest screen optimizations (PDA & NPC versions)[/p][/*][*][p]Sprint toggle now off by default[/p][/*][*][p]Controller input tweaks for better responsiveness[/p][/*][*][p]UI performance optimizations for smoother navigation[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]500,000 PLAYERS STRONG[/b][/h2][p][b]We've officially sold over half a million copies of ZERO Sievert.[/b] From a small bunker in the woods to a thriving community of survivors, you've carried this game on your backs. Every bug report, every build video, every wild raid story — [i]you[/i] made this possible.[/p][p]From all of us on the development team: [b]Thank you![/b][/p][p]We’re humbled, grateful, and more motivated than ever to keep making ZERO Sievert better.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]CELEBRATION SALE — 30% OFF[/b][/h2][p]Starting [b]Wednesday August 6th[/b], ZERO Sievert will be [b]30% off[/b] on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1782120/ZERO_Sievert/"]Steam[/url]. It’s the perfect time to get your friends geared up and send them into the Zone with you. With an [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1782120/ZERO_Sievert/"][b]85% "Very Positive" rating[/b][/url][b], we’re confident they’ll find a home in the bunker just like you did.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]As always, your feedback shapes ZERO Sievert.[/p][p]See you in the zone...
- The ZERO Sievert Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.13 | Patch notes
notes.content: [p]What's that? Another update?! Damn right it is! Sure, it's because we broke stuff... but you can't say we just left the bag, can you...[/p][p]Again, a massive [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who let us know you were experiencing issues and provided extra info on just how they were effecting you. This really helped and allowed us to quickly identify and resolve the issues. Here's the few notes for this hotfix:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue which caused the Prologue to crash[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused wolves to spawn out side of the map on the Prologue[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could die in the Prologue[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple localization issues[/p][/*][/list][p]These fixes combined should further improve the stability and overall experience of the game for you.[/p][p][/p][p]Again, the biggest [b]thank you[/b] to all of our players and community for providing insight and being patient while we fix these issues. We're a small dev team, but we're committed to ensuring an as smooth and positive experience as possible for you. If that is exactly what you're experiencing now, then please do leave us a Steam reviews to help get the word out all means the world to us.[/p][p][/p][p]We're ever grateful for every positive review we receive and can't explain how happy we are that you along for the ride with us. Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p]- ZERO Sievert Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.12 | Patch notes - Steam Deck and Prologue Fixes
notes.content:
[p]That's right! We fixed the Steam Deck and Prologue issues we introduced with the latest update (sorry about that...)[/p][p]A massive [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who let us know you were experiencing issues and provided extra info on just how they were effecting you. This really helped and allowed us to quickly identify and resolve the issues. 

For those wanting the specifics, here's the few notes for this hotfix:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue which prevented the game from loading correctly on Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Steam Deck users were unable to use consumables[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue which caused the Prologue (tutorial) to crash[/p][/*][/list][p]These fixes combined should immediately improve the stability and overall experience of the game for you (because who'd have thought being able to complete the tutorial was a good thing...).[/p][p][/p][p]Again, the biggest [b]thank you[/b] to all of our players and community for providing insight and being patient while we fix these issues. Being a small dev team, it's no surprise that we encounter these issues from time to time, but your support, especially in providing logs and information on bugs, sharing the game with your friends and leaving Steam reviews to help get the word out all means the world to us.[/p][p][/p][p]We've been trawling Steam reviews, responding and jumping in DMs with players to get extra info and resolve issues, but did you know we have an active Discord? Click the link below and join us over there where we can turn around feedback much faster than on Steam (most people refuse my friend invite as they think I'm a bot :( We even have a channel dedicated to Steam Deck chat! [url="https://discord.gg/DkTTUVF5qs"]https://discord.gg/DkTTUVF5qs[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We're ever grateful for every positive review we receive and can't explain how happy we are that you along for the ride with us. Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p]- ZERO Sievert Dev Team[/p]

notes.content:
[h1][b]THE PROLOGUE UPDATE IS LIVE - (Update 1.2.4)[/b][/h1][h3][/h3][h3][b]Buckle up Hunters, because The Prologue Update is here![/b][/h3][p]This update is packed with game-changing upgrades that will level up your entire experience. From smoother menus to smarter systems, we’ve supercharged everything to make your journey more intuitive immersive and downright fun. Let’s jump into the highlights.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="1MvWNHC2TVQ;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]New Game Flow and Difficulty Presets [/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added new Difficulty Setting flow with a redesigned selection process[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Difficulty Preset selection updated so that selecting any difficulty other than "Custom” now proceeds directly to the next page. And selecting “Custom” opens the existing Difficulty Modifier screen with new preset buttons[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Preset buttons now highlight in golden yellow to indicate selection, replacing the previous pip system[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Current menu selection for difficulty is visually emphasized with a highlight[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved visual clarity and interactivity for UI value sliders (e.g. volume mix)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Equipment loadouts can now be named for better customization and reference[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Removed news feed elements when full-screen menus are open to reduce clutter[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sprint toggle is now ON by default for all players [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Sleep Menu Enhancements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Bar is selected by default when opening the Sleep Menu[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Players can now drag the sleep duration bar and press the (A) button to sleep for the chosen amount (If only getting your 8 hours was this easy in real life!)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Controller users now see a clear button badge labelled “(A) Sleep” [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Trading and Inventory Updates [/b][/h3][list][*][p]Trade category buttons now feature a golden yellow icon to indicate the active selection[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Tooltip” renamed to “Item Info” for clarity[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Item Info behaviour for right-hand side items in the trade menu now matches the left side—hold the Item Info button to display details (gamepad-friendly)[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Healing and Repairing with NPCs [/b][/h3][list][*][p]Removed all decimal points when displaying values for buying or selling services[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]PDA Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Quest button now opens by default when accessing the PDA (swapped position with the Map button for easier navigation)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Quest label formatting updated from “Quest Giver: NAMEHERE” to “Giver: NAMEHERE”[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Introduced a grid system for the map to reflect explored areas more clearly (development note: "Luca problem")[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Map Selection and UI Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Selecting a map now instantly loads that map, removing the need for a separate “Go” button[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Map buttons now display the name of the location directly on or near the button[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Flavour text is displayed for the currently highlighted map to give more context and immersion[/p][/*][/list][p][b]That’s the rundown Hunters. Every tweak every fix every new feature in 1.2.1 was made to sharpen your edge out there. Whether you're bartering in the dust, creeping through the dark or catching a few hours of rest under a broken sky, these updates are built to keep you one step ahead in the Zone.
[/b][/p][p][b]Stay sharp, watch your corners and don’t let your guard down.[/b][/p]

tags.feature: Added new Difficulty Setting flow with a redesigned selection process

Difficulty Preset selection updated so that selecting any difficulty other than "Custom” now proceeds directly to the next page. And selecting “Custom” opens the existing Difficulty Modifier screen with new preset buttons
Preset buttons now highlight in golden yellow to indicate selection, replacing the previous pip system
Current menu selection for difficulty is visually emphasized with a highlight
Improved visual clarity and interactivity for UI value sliders (e.g. volume mix)
Equipment loadouts can now be named for better customization and reference
Removed news feed elements when full-screen menus are open to reduce clutter
Sprint toggle is now ON by default for all players
Bar is selected by default when opening the Sleep Menu
Players can now drag the sleep duration bar and press the (A) button to sleep for the chosen amount (If only getting your 8 hours was this easy in real life!)
Controller users now see a clear button badge labelled “(A) Sleep”
Trade category buttons now feature a golden yellow icon to indicate the active selection
“Tooltip” renamed to “Item Info” for clarity
Item Info behaviour for right-hand side items in the trade menu now matches the left side—hold the Item Info button to display details (gamepad-friendly)

tags.balance_change: Removed all decimal points when displaying values for buying or selling services

tags.feature: Quest button now opens by default when accessing the PDA (swapped position with the Map button for easier navigation)
Quest label formatting updated from “Quest Giver: NAMEHERE” to “Giver: NAMEHERE”
Introduced a grid system for the map to reflect explored areas more clearly (development note: "Luca problem")
Selecting a map now instantly loads that map, removing the need for a separate “Go” button
Map buttons now display the name of the location directly on or near the button
Flavour text is displayed for the currently highlighted map to give more context and immersion

notes.title: MORE MOD TOOLS UPDATES! - Patch 1.1.15 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]🛠️ ZERO Sievert – Patch 1.1.15 | Patch Notes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/6c72d9790e1bd9245df35d22f47ba5cdbb88f56c.png[/img]

[h2]🐛 Bug Fixes & Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Inventory sorting now works as expected when sorted by type – thanks to those who reported the bug!
[*] Fixed an animation bug with consumables.
[*] Cleaned up the news feed: no more raw Steam image URLs.
[*] Fixed Quick move stash prompt overlapping with item tooltips.
[*] Mods that create lots of quests won’t crash the game anymore (hopefully...).
[*] UI improvements to the mods menu.
[*] A couple of crashes related to modded quests and sprites have been fixed
[*] Security fixes for Catspeak, the modding API: we fixed some possible exploits (Thanks "I'm An Issue" and "Katsaii"!)
[/list]
With more stable mods there's no better time to start tasting what the community is cooking if you haven't modded the game already.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/8bf329f92c5c084bbd28c5046ed712b9b6e4813a.png[/img]

[h2]🛠️ Modding Tools Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Time of day functions now available (see doc!)
[*] Added functions to get the current second, minute, hour, day, month, and year
[*] Loadouts are now modifiable – customize what gear players start with. (did we say to check the doc already?)
[*] FactionExists() function added for modding
[*] Ownership support for Workshop items ("author_id" tag to the meta.ini file)
[*] Modded backpack items now show up on your character!
[*] Added missing NPC functions for modding, NpcSetFootstep() and NpcSetHp()
[/list]

[h2]📖 New Game Events for Modding[/h2]

Trigger your own stories and systems with these new mod-accessible events:
[list]
[*] "enter_hub" ➡️ Called once when the hub room is entered. This means when you start a new game/load a save, or return from a raid.
[*] "enter_raid" ➡️ Called once when the raid is started. Specifically this runs right after you continue past the loading screen.
[*] "exit_train" ➡️ Called once when the player gets off the train during a raid. This is performed immediately after the player position near the train.
[*] "player_spawn" ➡️ Called once when the player spawns into the world. This will occur when you first enter any (Game Maker) room/level.
[*] "player_death" ➡️ Called once when the player dies during raids.
[*] "trade_completed" ➡️ Called whenever the player successfully completes a trade with a trader.
[/list]
Show us what you can do with them.
We also lovingly updated the documentation with all of this and more, don't forget to check it out!

[h2]🔚 ZERO Sievert Out[/h2]

We really wanted to push this update out as soon as possible as many of you are hard at work on mods at the moment.
The team has also started working on the next major update, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.13 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]🛠️ ZERO Sievert – Hotfix 1.1.13 | Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]💬 Here We Go Again[/h2]

You know how it goes… New update drops, some bugs sneak through the cracks, and everything's a little... crunchy. So we’ve kicked down the bunker door and patched up a bunch of stuff in 1.1.13. This one’s a hotfix to clean up after the last update (yeah, we saw the reports…), but we’ve also thrown in some quality-of-life tweaks and tasty new modding features because why not? Read on for all the good (and weird) stuff we fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/8bf329f92c5c084bbd28c5046ed712b9b6e4813a.png[/img]

[h2]🧰 New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Additional modding tool features added
[*] Ability to add Workbench recipes to modded items (found in the documentation under: Functions > Crafting > CraftingRecipeCreate)
[*] Steam Workshop mods you've created can now be updated by pressing the upload button on the mods menu
[/list]
[h2]📖 Modding Tools Documentation[/h2]
[list]
[*] Consumable documentation has been filled (found in the documentation under: Functions > Items > Consumables)
[*] Other minor updates/changes (notably with the 'SpriteGet' function)
[/list]
[h2]🔧 Other Notable Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] A crash when launching the game has been reported in connection with installing Steam Workshop mods. A failsafe has been added to prevent crashing the game and highlight to you via the Main Menu when a mod has caused an issue.
[*] Re-fix: Monitors larger than a 16:9 aspect ratio display black bars (as they used to).
[*] Both the Carret N82 and Pistol .50 BMG can both be repaired using the blue weapons repair kit(s).
[/list]
[h2]🌍 Localisation[/h2]
[list]
[*] Localisation has been provided for the Additional Options page in the Settings menu.
[*] Updated The Guide’s dialogue to fix a grammatical error.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/6c72d9790e1bd9245df35d22f47ba5cdbb88f56c.png[/img]

[h2]🎮 Gameplay Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Assigning the “Teleport” key binding to num keys 1–6 will not teleport the Hunter to the stash, it will only open the teleport menu allowing you to enter another number to teleport.
[*] Controller support has been re-added following engine updates to select languages.
[*] Further controller navigation has been added for navigating through the Mods menu.
[/list]
[h2]🐞 Other Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Targets to be eliminated for the “Soldier Work” daily quest no longer spawn outside of map bounds.
[*] The “Difficulty” selection button on the Main Menu has been hidden to avoid any confusion on its lack of functionality.
[*] Any grass around where the Unknown Bag spawns towards the end of The Crystal has been mowed to make the bag more obvious.
[*] The glow from lasers and torches are hidden while using an item (e.g. healing or eating).
[*] NPCs no longer spawn outside the map in small handfuls.
[*] Hunter dialogue system after completing First Steps has been adjusted to prompt players to speak to the Barman again.
[*] The “Handyman” Achievement exploit has been addressed.
[*] The “Handyman” Achievement now tracks the use of repair kits, not just repairing via the workbench.
[/list]
[h2]🔚 ZERO Sievert Out[/h2]

That’s the cleanup report for 1.1.13. Appreciate all the bug reports and the chaos you bring to the zone, keep it coming! We’ll be back soon with more updates, more fixes, and probably more ways to accidentally break the game 🙄. Until then, take what you can, give nothing back!

notes.title: MODDING & STEAM WORKSHOP - Patch 1.1.12
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Hunters![/h3]
Today we’re excited to announce the official launch of Modding Tools for ZERO Sievert with patch 1.1.12.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/5946c85e2c1efca487f322b65b8007f51fd274a2.jpg[/img]

[b]🛠️ MODDING TOOLS[/b]
The Steam Workshop is officially open in Zakov, bringing a new post-apocalyptic world of possibilities for modding!

What does this mean for hunters? Modders can now create and share thrilling new mods that introduce new items, quests, weapons, NPCs, objects, scripts, sounds, languages, traders, particles, events, factions, and much more.

The Steam Workshop Train has left the station and will continue to grow and expand with thrilling new mods, so keep an eye out for any favourites! To find out more about what this means for the game, check out Oscar Mikey's video below! 

[previewyoutube=4xboFImQ85I;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/8bf329f92c5c084bbd28c5046ed712b9b6e4813a.png[/img]
[list][*]Added in tools to support modding in ZERO Sievert and compatibility with Steam Workshop
[/*][list][*]Documentation for this (including various functions and examples) is included in the local game files and will be updated accordingly when relevant for the foreseeable
[/*][/list][*]Updated GameMaker Engine from v2022.0.2.49 to v2024.11.0.226
[/*][list][*]This engine upgrade allowed us to fix some legacy issues that we previously couldn’t
[/*][*]Since we’re now on a newer version of GameMaker, some users may experience better performance on laptop GPUs
[/*][/list][*]New quest added after "The bridge to Zakov" named "Clear the way, again"
[/*][*]New quest added after "Clear the way, again" named "The Devil"
[/*][*]New boss added (Available ONLY after completing the "Clear the way, again" quest)
[/*][*]2 new weapons added: 
[/*][list][*]Pistol .50 BMG
[/*][*]Carret N82
[/*][list][*].50BMG rounds can be bought by the barman after completing the "Clear the way, again" quest. (Must wait for the next traders restock.)
[/*][/list][/list][*]New armor added:
[/*][list][*]WA Devil suit (unique boss drop)
[/*][/list][*]1 new foregrip added (with 3 color variants)
[/*][*]2 color variants added for already existing foregrip
[/*][/list]

[h3]Other Notable Improvements[/h3]
[*] New audio slider: “UI Radiation” slider has been added to increase or decrease the volume for the geiger counter clicking SFX when hovering over menu items
[*] Difficulty settings can be changed mid game (some setting may requires a new raid or a trader restock or reload the bunker)
[*] An enemy’s weapon and armour will always be revealed immediately when checking them for loot
[*] Localisation added to all the achievements for the current supported languages

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/6c72d9790e1bd9245df35d22f47ba5cdbb88f56c.png[/img]
[*][b]Collision[/b]
[/*][list][*]Further collision adjustments have been made to stop Hunters from being teleported into the blue void
[/*][*]Throwing bolts when the Hunter is backed up against a wall won’t cause the bolt to get stuck on the wall
[/*][/list]
[*][b]Inventory Fixes[/b]
[/*][list][*]Drop Armor setting is functional and a new difficulty page for “Loot - Armor” has been added. In this page, armor tiers (0-3, 4, 5, and 6) are given player-defined difficulty sliders for drop chance and the minimum and maximum durability for armor found on enemies
[/*][*]Hunters purchasing items from traders when the item cannot fit in their inventory will find the item on the ground next to them after the purchase
[/*][/list]
[*][b]Graphical Fixes[/b]
[/*][list][*]Flashbangs detonated as the Hunter is dying no longer flashbang the player (yes, you!) on death
[/*][*]If the Hunter gets flashbanged before entering a building, the flash effect will not stay on permanently until death
[/*][*]Areas around the ghoul tunnels have been redesigned to make the entrances more obvious
[/*][*]The area around the Mall underground passage during “The Bridge to Zakov” has also been changed slightly to make the entrance more obvious
[/*][/list]
[*][b]Localisation[/b]
[/*][list][*]Several grammatical issues fixed in the Tutorial for multiple categories
[/*][*]Added missing localisation text options for the Anomaly
[/*][/list]
[*][b]NPC Behaviour/Interactions[/b]
[/*][list][*]Yakim and Vadim will no longer repeat their dialogue text until the player exits the save game
[/*][*]Quest rewards can no longer be replaced for rewards from other quests
[/*][/list]
[*][b]Performance/System[/b]
[/*][list][*]Audio will play to the original output device if it is disconnected from the PC after it is reconnected
[/*][*]Temporary freezes in the bunker when opening full inventories or mass-trading have been reduced
[/*][/list]
[*][b]UI[/b]
[/*][list][*]News feed on the Main Menu shows date and text without an overlap
[/*][*]Player can interact with news feed after accessing any fullscreen menu
[/*][*]Fixed some improper kerning present in the Tutorial
[/*][*]Loading screen hints have been rechecked to remove any text relating to the pre-1.0 skill system
[/*][/list]
[*][b]Weapon Fixes[/b]
[/*][list][*]Kibba’s weapon can be fixed using the appropriate repair kit immediately after collecting
[/*][*]When shooting while moving, the trajectory of the last bullet in the magazine will no longer vary wildly from the previous bullets shot
[/*][/list]
[*][b]Other Fixes[/b]
[/*][list][*]All keyboard keys can be used for remapping with the exception of: Backspace; Clear; Fn; and Mouse inputs (these are being worked on)
[/*][*]The Swamp village is displayed at the same brightness as the rest of the Swamp, no matter the time of day
[/*][*]Achievement “Man about town” cannot be unlocked by using alternative means outside the unlock description
[/*][*]Rainy weather will not persist into other weather events in the Bunker if Hunters sleep through the transition
[/*][*]Scientist Work daily quest: chemical anomalies will not be generated inside the power grid in the Mall
[/*][*]Scientist Work daily quest: dead scientists have been moved around in the Industrial Area so they are accessible, but note that they may still be partly buried or hard to find
[/*][/list]
[*][b]Upcoming Hotfix Note[/b]
[/*][list][*]An additional note we wanted to expand on for our next hotfix was the Modding documentation. We’ll be iterating on this and adding more information as needed in future hotfixes so if there is anything you’d like to see, let us know!
[/*][/list]

We can't wait to see what modding brings to Zakov and as always, thank you to everyone who has been helping report issues so we can improve ZERO Sievert!

P.S - [i]If you previously used unofficial mods in ZERO Sievert you may encounter file conflicts when booting the game after 1.1.12. If this happens we recommend uninstalling and reinstalling the game to fix it.[/i]

notes.title: ZERO Sievert | Weather Update
notes.content:
[h3]Hunters, brace yourselves[/h3]
Zakov just got a whole lot more unpredictable! We’re excited to introduce our latest update 1.0.16, which brings a dynamic weather system, seasons, and a new survival mechanic to the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/28727631e1bf00b9f3cac2b9c812df3aa61fa17d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/8bf329f92c5c084bbd28c5046ed712b9b6e4813a.png[/img]
🌍 [b]New Weather System[/b]
[i][b]Snow is Back for Good! [/b][/i]❄️ No more waiting—Zakov’s harsh winters are here to stay.
[b][i]Seasons in the Wasteland:[/i][/b] Every two in-game weeks now represents a full year, bringing changing temperatures and climates to every raid location.
[b][i]Real-Time Weather Updates:[/i][/b] Weather conditions shift every 3 in-game hours, affecting temperature, visibility, and survival strategies.

🛠️ [b]New Survival Tool & Visual Enhancements[/b]
[b][i]Weather Kit:[/i][/b] You can now craft a Weather Kit to monitor temperature on your PDA and check the next 6 hours of weather at each location before heading out.
[b][i]Enhanced Weather Effects:[/i][/b] We’ve added new shaders to bring in greater immersion - for example, rainy days now appear desaturated and dimly lit for a truly moody atmosphere. We’ve also added a toggle setting to disable the new color gradient overlay for extra accessibility and customisation.

🔥 [b]Other Improvements[/b]
[b][i]Hunter & Gun Skills Notification:[/i][/b] A new PDA icon alerts you when you have unspent skill points - never forget to utilise your points again!

Alongside these new features we’ve also been working on some bug fixes which we know have been troubling many of you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/6c72d9790e1bd9245df35d22f47ba5cdbb88f56c.png[/img]
[list][*]Steam Cloud saving is fixed (new check with communicating with Steam)
[/*][*]Inventory sorting fixes to prevent icon overlaps
[/*][*]Inventory auto-sort and rotation fixes
[/*][*]More fixes implemented towards blue void issue
[/*][*]Player is now able to sell Santa’s backpack
[/*][*]Immortality Hunter Skill does not occupy a Tier-1 skill slot, allowing full roster of skills to be acquired
[/*][/list]
Thank you as always to everyone who has been reporting issues to us over on our Discord server! Now get out there, prepare for the unpredictable, adapt to the elements, and stay sharp Hunters! 🌧️🌨️🌤️

notes.title: ZERO Sievert | Bunker Report - Episode 6
notes.content:
Hello hunters and welcome back to the bunker! 

[previewyoutube=eNVyS7UVpdk;full][/previewyoutube]

[i][b]Here is what we cover in today's episode of the Bunker Report 🫡[/b][/i]

For those who haven't played since Early Access, did you know we have a new Weapons Skill System?

Here's a rundown of what this means:

[h3]Weapon Skill System[/h3][list][*]Introduced a [b]Weapon Skills System[/b] to enhance combat progression.
[/*][*]Gain [b]XP[/b] for weapon use (eliminating enemies, hunting, etc.).
[/*][*]Weapons are categorized into six types:
[list][*][b]Pistols[/b]
[/*][*][b]Submachine Guns[/b]
[/*][*][b]Shotguns[/b]
[/*][*][b]Rifles[/b]
[/*][*][b]DMRs[/b]
[/*][*][b]Snipers[/b]
[/*][/list][/*][*]As proficiency increases, [b]preset stats improve automatically[/b].
[/*][*][b]Perk System Added:[/b]
[list][*]Unlock perks at set XP levels per weapon type.
[/*][*]Example: DMR perk allows reloading while scoped in.
[/*][*]More perks to customize your combat style!
[/*][/list][/*][*]Check the [b]PDA > Weapon Skill System[/b] for progress tracking.[/*][/list]
[h3]Community Competition: #MakeShiftRun[/h3][list][*][b]Final 30 Hours[/b] to submit entries for the [b]#MakeShiftRun speedrun competition[/b]! 
[/*][*]Objective: [b]Reach Makeshift Camp as quickly as possible[/b] in a new game.
[/*][*]Rules:

notes.title: ZERO Sievert | Bunker Report - Episode 3
notes.content:
Hello hunters and welcome back to the bunker! 

One of the recent topics of discussion on here has been about this series itself, with players unsure or confused about the purpose of these videos and what they can expect from them going forward. 

Well be confused no longer! The whole point of these videos is to have yet another outlet where we can interact with you and share information. From looking at the Steam discussion comments, there seemed to be many of you who thought these videos sole purpose were letting you know about game updates. While we’ll always include the most up to date information possible for you, as we’re a small team, sadly that means we won’t always have tons of big development updates weekly, but what we can do is let you know about reported issues and what we’re doing to address them, give you community updates and recommend content creators for you to check out, to name just a few topics!

Another thing we realised was the discussion title and thumbnail being called the 'Bunker Update' potentially being misleading and many of you we're hoping for it to be an actual update in the in-game bunker. Therefore, we've changed the wording to title this series more appropriately to avoid any further confusion. 

In these videos we also want to spotlight your community queries and most reported bugs of the week. So definitely let us know down below if there's something you want us to address!

Here's a list of things we cover in today's episode of the Bunker Report!
[list]
[*]Queries about the aspect ratio
[*]Players being unable to sell the Christmas Backpack from the Holiday event
[*]Players are experiencing switching audio whilst playing the game
[*]Bug where icons overlap and merge when trading
[*]Overall game balancing
[*]S*x update???
[/list]
We will endeavor to dedicate time to answering as many of your questions as possible - if we have something to give you an update on, so keep the questions coming in the discussion below.

We hope you enjoy this week's Bunker Report and as always happy hunting!

notes.content:
IT’S TIMEEE! 🔔🎄

Get ready for a truly festive event this season because Santa is back and with a BANG 💥 For all the new hunters that have joined us this year and for those who might have missed out on last year's festivities, we’ve brought Santa back to bring some Christmas sleigh to Zakov! 🛷

notes.title: Update 1.0.7 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[quote] Hello Hunters!

We’re releasing a new patch today [b]1.0.7[/b] to fix a number of issues that we’ve been tracking either from our ongoing testing internally, or from community reports.

[i](For those interested in game dev, the reason for the build is 1.0.7 instead of 1.0.6 is because there were a couple of fixes in our 1.0.6 candidate yesterday which needed additional work –so we don’t release that one, and move on to a new build which contains that additional work.)[/i][/quote]
[h3]FIXES[/h3]
•	Vehicles sometimes preventing access to be able to loot quest item (key)
•	Entrance to Makeshift Lab sometimes being blocked by objects
•	Some endgame choices clip offscreen in specific circumstances
•	Multiple chests close to each other are hard to access when using a controller
•	First Blood achievement not unlocking when killing certain wildlife
•	Legacy placeholder image for raid selection screen updated to remove unused boxes
•	Lighting in the Lab can abruptly change from dark to bright
•	Several instances of spelling errors
•	Permadeath tooltip text clipping
•	Rad Pill buff displaying wrong colour
•	Scrapping a stack of generic items only yields a single scrap material
•	Scrapping items increases carry capacity
•	Tooltip not updating to new correct magazine size after crafting
•	Gear Lover skill does not affect weapons
•	Industrial area quest locations sometimes inaccessible
•	Added “Are you sure?” prompt when uninstalling a module
•	Infirmary module not healing at the expected rate (it was using real-life minutes instead of in-game minutes)
•	Some walls within Zakov City are missing collisions
•	The Bandit Camp is occasionally inaccessible
•	Selling Vlasov’s dogtag will prevent the quest from being completed
•	Hovering over an item before it is revealed will show its identity in the tooltip
•	Sometimes enemies can wander outside of the map boundaries on Makeshift Camp map
•	Unable to remap inputs to the ‘R’ key on keyboard
•	Joining a faction does not impact reputation or quest availability with a rival faction
•	Difficult to see the Ghoul tunnel in The Machinery quest
•	Default attachments for some weapons are incompatible once removed
•	Transition from dry to rain storm can sometimes happen too suddenly
•	Several instances of text missing localisations (some, but not all)
•	Radio Tower in Makeshift Camp is sometimes inaccessible
•	Weapon repair kits at 0-60 are not inclusive of 60%
•	Player is (very rarely) randomly transported to a blank, blue map (we are creating a temporary workaround for this while we continue to investigate the root cause)
•	Big Boned skill incorrectly applying weight reduction to additional armor sets


[h3]BALANCE CHANGES[/h3]
•	NPCs now drop scrap weapons, armor and ammunition
•	Emissions will happen later in a raid (after the 20+ minutes mark)
•	Heavy acid rain will only happen after an emission (it cannot be present during normal gameplay)
•	Big's tooth value and spawn chance increased
•	When accepting the quest "Psy Helmet p1" both oil factory keys are given to the player
•	Endurance Booster Injector has been buffed
•	The sale value of Roubles is always 1
•	Endgame areas now have more supply chests (to provide better sustainability against the higher amount of enemies)
•	Arman and Orel no longer shoot AP rounds and have slightly more loot
•	The Mall Guns store locked room has had its loot updated

[h3]ERROR WORKAROUND[/h3]
Meanwhile we also have a workaround for anybody getting [b]“TexturesM.cpp”[/b] or [b]“VertexBuilderM.cpp”[/b] errors when playing the game. If you experience this issue, please manually select “High Performance” in Windows as follows:

Open Windows Settings -> Select Graphics Settings -> Select Graphics Performance Preference
Find ZERO Sievert in the list -> Select Options -> Select High Performance

Please note that if it is not in the list by default, select Browse, and locate the game’s .exe file (the standard location for this is Program Files x86/Steam/Steamapps/Common/ZERO Sievert/)

[h3]ONGOING[/h3]
Finally, just a note that we’re still working on the following reported issues:

•	Delete Cloud Saves option also deletes local saves
•	Turn-in prompt text sometimes not appearing after the first raid
•	Switching ammo type on gamepad when in the bunker will display teleport menu
•	Placement and removal of markers when using controller is inconsistent
•	NPC Drop Armor menu setting issue
•	Mouse drift in windowed more or when using a second screen
•	Mr Junk sometimes has no items to trade
•	Immediately looting modules sometimes means they will be empty

Once again, thanks for all your support!

notes.title: ZERO Sievert 1.0 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Greetings Hunters,

It’s finally time to board the train to Zakov City because [b]ZERO Sievert version 1.0[/b] is now available on PC Steam as we officially leave Early Access! 1.0 also brings a plethora of new additions including a brand new city map, deadly new weapons, hunter skills to level up, and much more!

Check out the launch trailer below:

[previewyoutube=yjqkNY_SRQ4;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote]ZERO Sievert is a tense, top-down, post-apocalyptic survival shooter that challenges players to scavenge, fight, and survive in a dangerous, procedurally generated wasteland. 

You must head out on excursions into the wild to scavenge supplies, take out enemies and get safely back to the bunker - and be warned; the nuclear fallout may have impacted some of the local wildlife…. Multiple questlines will guide you through the world of ZERO Sievert. As you journey through, you’ll slowly unravel information and lore about the devastated world that’s been left behind. There are more than 100 different items to loot which can be used to craft new items, upgrade your own base, and trade.[/quote]
Make sure to follow our official channels on [url=https://x.com/ZeroSievert]Twitter/X[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@modernwolf_]TikTok[/url] to keep up to date with all things ZERO Sievert. The [url=https://discord.com/invite/sievert]Discord server[/url] is also a great place to come hang out with us and the rest of the community, to chat all things ZERO Sievert!.

As always stay safe out there and happy hunting!

Onto the patch notes:

With the release of 1.0 our primary focus in the coming days and weeks will be keeping a close eye on any bug reports and gameplay feedback we receive from the community, and we will be ready to work on hotfixes or patches accordingly.

After this, we will be turning our attention to additional updates to the game, starting with [b]Steam Workshop support[/b] - though please be aware, we don’t have a timeline for this yet. More details on this will be shared in the next couple of months.

Big thank You to all our early access players for sticking through this journey with us and excited to see all the new hunters board the train to Zakov!

notes.title: Important Information about 1.0
notes.content:
Greetings Hunters, 

There is less than one week left till the release of update 1.0 and we have some important news to share about the game.

[h3]Price Increase After Early Access[/h3]
With the official 1.0 release, we wanted to give you advance warning that ZERO Sievert's price will be increasing (as noted in our Early Access FAQs on the Steam store page) from $19.99 and equivalents to $24.99 and equivalents. It’s quite common for games to have a lower price during Early Access to recognise that players who support a game earlier in development often have to put up with more than their fair share of bugs and other issues, as well as less actual content…and for those of you who did, we thank you!

[h3]🎉 10% Discount Before the Price Increase[/h3]
However, we’re letting you know now so that anybody who has been watching for a while but so far didn’t buy the game, could do so before the price increases - and to help further we’re currently offering a [b]10% discount on ZERO Sievert[/b] that will be in place up until the 1.0 launch! So if you've been considering diving into the wasteland or know friends who'd love to join the adventure, this is your last chance to grab the game at its current Early Access price with that extra discount. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1782120/ZERO_Sievert/

[h3]‘Save Wipe’ Notice[/h3]
To ensure a smooth and balanced experience with all the new content in version 1.0, we’ll also be performing a save wipe. We will be creating a legacy branch on Steam that will allow you to keep playing your previous saves (more details on how to access this will come around the 1.0 release) - however, we do encourage you to load up a fresh save to experience the new systems, features, and bug fixes implemented in 1.0.

[h3]Thank You for Your Support![/h3]
Your dedication and feedback throughout Early Access has been the driving force behind this game’s evolution. We're so grateful to have such a passionate community, and we can’t wait for you all to experience the full version of ZERO Sievert next week!

Make sure to take advantage of the 10% discount, gear up for the challenges ahead, and we’ll see you out in Zakov soon. 

Good hunting!

notes.title: Developer Update 2024 Vol.7
notes.content:
Greetings Hunters, 

The release of [b]update 1.0[/b] is just around the corner and we're bringing a wave of exciting new content and enhancements to ZERO Sievert. Prepare to dive back into the chaos with a brand-new city map, face off against a formidable new boss, unlock deadly new weapons, level up your hunter skills, and much more! 

Let’s take a sneak peek into what's coming in update 1.0.

[h3]🏙️CITY MAP[/h3]

Chaos continues in the brand new City Map that takes you further into the urban ruins of ZERO Sievert’s post-apocalyptic world. Be on the lookout for hidden dangers and discover valuable loot amongst the rubble and finally uncover the origins of Zakov. 

This map is sure to provide plenty of opportunities to test your survival skills against threats and even a new terrifying opponent that lurks in the shadowy alleys and abandoned buildings. The struggle will be intense, but the reward may prove to be worth every bullet fired. 👀 

We can’t wait till you get the chance to explore this sprawling urban battlefield, but till then check out the City Map Teaser trailer below!

[previewyoutube=_W33ctnqbAU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🎯HUNTER SKILLS & NEW WEAPONS[/h3]

We're also introducing Hunter Skills to update 1.0! This is a completely new progression system that lets you develop your hunter’s abilities as you level up! These skills will be extremely useful in enhancing chances of survival and allowing you to navigate the toxic wasteland in your playstyle. 

Here’s a little preview of a few of the ones we’ve added out of [b]22 Hunter Skills[/b] that will be arriving in update 1.0. 

[b]Mule[/b]
Increase max weight by 5kg and allows you to move at a slow walking speed, even when incredibly over-encumbered.

[b]Loot Goblin[/b] 
Increase looting speed by 50%

[b]Immortal[/b]
Once per raid, when something should have killed you, you are healed by 50hp

[b]Field Medic[/b]
Decreases the amount of time required to use meds by 50%

[b]Grenade expert[/b]
Increase all grenades radius by 30%

On top of that, we've added [b]8 new weapons[/b] to your arsenal. Experiment with these deadly tools, each designed to help you dominate in the harsh landscapes of ZERO Sievert. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/b8ff7cc345ac6fce8ca463523564f4b5cd09e221.png[/img]
[i]This is just a preview of a few of the new weapons we’ve added[/i]

[h3]🏆STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS[/h3]

One for the completionists, we’re bringing Steam Achievements! Track your progress and unlock achievements as you conquer Zakov. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/c490ab6d87a3da001994d7c5e4422735e6967640.jpg[/img]

[h3]⚙️QOL UPDATES[/h3] 

As always we’ve been hard at work getting through a huge polishing project for ZERO Sievert, from the UI improvements, gameplay enhancements to minor bugs and major performance refinements to ensure your time spent in Zakov is seamless and immersive. So far, we’ve squashed over 150 bugs for this release and aim to continuously refine the build for launch!

Due to the sheer amount of quality of life updates that we have implemented for 1.0, we can’t list them all at the  moment, but here's a highlight of some of the ones we know have been niggling the community.

[list]
[*] Weapons can now only spawn in loot boxes with compatible attachments
[*] Weapon tooltip now displays gun types
[*] Lootboxes no longer spawn in unreachable places on the Industrial area map
[*] Forest map houses can no longer be blocked from entering by water
[*] Crows no longer get stuck in a loop!
[*] Map now centralises on player in the PDA
[*] Unlocked maps are no longer greyed out
[/list] and lots more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/300a4298ca914d6b545f82cee7523adcd7783f81.png[/img]

-

Whether you’re a veteran hunter or a newcomer to the game, we can’t wait to see you dive back in and explore all the new content that is coming very soon. As always, a big thank you to all our Early Access players, for your constant support and valuable feedback, we couldn’t have made it to 1.0 without all of you!

[b]ZERO Sievert is also currently 10% OFF[/b] to celebrate its upcoming launch, so definitely grab it now whilst it's on sale. 

Till then, stay sharp and good hunting!

notes.title: Update 0.52 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Hunters,

We’re excited to announce that 0.52 is now live! Just make sure to update your game to continue your journey through Zakov. 

As mentioned in our dev blog last week, this update will be introducing a new skills system to ZERO Sievert that will replace the legacy gun skills. We’re looking forward to seeing what you think about the [b]24 new skills[/b] we’ve added! 

Without further ado, let’s get into the patch notes.


[h1][b]Patch Notes 0.52[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/8bf329f92c5c084bbd28c5046ed712b9b6e4813a.png[/img]
We’ve introduced [b]24 New Weapon Skills[/b] and gun types that only get better the more you use them.

All new weapon skills:
[list]
[*]Close Quarters Training
[b][i]Description:[/i][/b] Minimum effective range of this weapon is reduced by 40%
[b][i]Weapons classes applicable[/i]:[/b] Assault Rifles tier.2, DMRs tier.2, Sniper Rifles tier.3

[*]Reload Artist: Scopes
[b][i]Description:[/i][/b] Allows you to remain zoomed-in while reloading this weapon when scoped
[b][i]Weapons classes applicable[/i]:[/b] DMRs tier.1, Sniper Rifles tier.1

[*]Reload Artist: Speed Reload
[b][i]Description:[/i][/b] Double-press the reload button to speed up the reload process of magazine-fed weapons, but any ammunition already in the magazine will be lost
[b][i]Weapons classes applicable[/i]:[/b] Pistols tier.2, SMGs tier.1, Shotguns tier.2, Assault Rifles tier.1, DMRs tier.2

[*]Reload Artist: Double barrel
[b][i]Description:[/i][/b] Allows double-barreled shotguns to be reloaded in one go by inserting both shells at once

[*]Run and Gun
[b][i]Description:[/i][/b] You can now shoot this weapon while sprinting
[b][i]Weapons classes applicable[/i]:[/b] Pistols tier.1, Shotguns tier.2

[*]Marksman Awareness
[b][i]Description:[/i][/b] When using this weapon while scoped, you will be able to partially see the area beyond the reticle interface, while the cross-hair will also be instantly visible
[b][i]Weapons classes applicable[/i]:[/b] DMRs tier.1, Sniper Rifles tier.1

[*]Fast Focus
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] Hover over the target with the cursor to make the cross-hair shrink more quickly
[i][b]Weapon classes applicable:[/b][/i] SMGs tier.1, Assault Rifles tier.1, DMRs tier.1, Sniper Rifles tier.1

[*]Fast Hands
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] Switching to this type of weapon is 50% faster
[i][b]Weapons classes applicable:[/b][/i]  Pistols tier.1, SMGs tier.2, DMRs tier.2, Sniper Rifles tier.2

[*]Penetrating Shot
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] A killing shot will result in the bullet continuing on its path to hit a second target behind the first
[i][b]Weapons classes applicable:[/b][/i] SMGs tier.3, Shotguns tier.3, Assault Rifles tier.3, DMRs tier.3, Sniper Rifles tier.3

[*]Empowered Backup
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] For 2.5 seconds after swapping to this weapon, all shots will have 15% increased damage
[i][b]Weapons classes applicable:[/b][/i] Pistols tier.1, SMGs tier.2, Shotguns tier.1

[*]First Bullet
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] The first bullet of each magazine deals 30% more damage
[i][b]Weapons classes applicable:[/b][/i] Pistols tier.2, Shotguns tier.3, Assault Rifles tier.2, DMRs tier.3, Sniper Rifles tier.3

[*]Impaler shot
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] Hitting an enemy will decrease its speed by 30% for 1 second
[i][b]Additional:[/b][/i] Speed decrease duration is increased to 2 seconds for sniper rifles
[i][b]Weapons classes applicable:[/b][/i] Pistols tier.3, SMGs tier.2, Shotguns tier.1, Assault Rifles tier.2, Sniper Rifles tier.2

[*]Prolonged Vision
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] When you hit a target they will remain visible for 2 seconds when going out of sight
[i][b]Weapons classes applicable:[/b][/i] Pistols tier.2, SMGs tier.2, Assault Rifles tier.1, Sniper Rifles tier.2

[*]Killer Reload
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] Increase reload speed by 20% for 1.5 seconds after killing an enemy
[i][b]Weapons classes applicable:[/b][/i] SMGs tier.2, Shotguns tier.1, Assault Rifles tier.2

[*]Vital Shooting
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] By hovering over a target with your cursor for a short time before shooting, the shot will ignore some of its armor

[*]Improvised Sniper
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] Hovering over the target with the cursor for 1 second will increase the maximum effective range of the weapon for that shot
[i][b]Weapon classes applicable:[/b][/i] Assault Rifles tier.1

[*]Shotgun Master
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] If using Slug ammunition the maximum effective range is increased
[i][b]Weapon classes applicable:[/b][/i] Shotguns tier.2

[*]Phantom Bullets
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] When shooting Automatic weapons for at least 0.3 seconds, you can continue shooting for a short time even after the magazine is empty
[i][b]Weapon classes applicable:[/b][/i] SMGs tier.3, Assault Rifles tier.3

[*]Crosshair Myopia
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] Increases the radius of the circle in which the cursor must stay to avoid glancing shots

[*]Emergency Sprint
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] After switching to this weapon, your movement speed will increase by 20% for 3 seconds

[*]Armour? No Problem
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] All shots have an additional 20% chance to penetrate armour

[*]Suppressive Fire
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] Provides a 15% damage boost to weapons while firing continuously for 0.5 seconds

[*]Flank Master
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] If you are undetected, or not in the viewing cone of an enemy, you will receive a 15% damage boost

[*]Steady Sniper
[i][b]Description:[/b][/i] After hitting an enemy while scoped, the optic crosshair will have double the Ergonomics statistic for 2 seconds
[/list]
[h3]Other Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] First Time User Experience prompts - NPCs are more chatty when you first start a game and might comment on the success or failure of starting raids
[*] Improved support for Steam Deck
[*] Exit sign on Bunker 
[*] Improved display for debug controls
[*] Localisation for new features
[*] Legacy gun skills removed (replaced with new Weapon Skills system)
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/6c72d9790e1bd9245df35d22f47ba5cdbb88f56c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Steam deck functionality being inconsistent when playing with KB & M
[*] Fixed a crash involving stacking items from Hideout stash into player inventory
[*] Fixed issue where you could spam shoot to stop the reload being finished for single bullet fed guns
[*] Fixed wrong word prompt being displayed for actions on some gamepads
[*] All DMRs are no longer included in sniper perks
[*] Inventory now displays correct controls when the player remaps them
[*] Connecting a gamepad when booting up the game now displays correct text size
[*] Added different button prompt icons to match the icons for the main gamepad manufacturers
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/51669bbc78090bb84d7c38d8038eb27c570e42be.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Player damage blood graphic size reduced, no longer obscures the close-up
[*] Teleporting now functional when you have a weapon equipped
[*] Player inventory can no longer be opened at the same time as the weapon closeup
[*] Player location will now display on the map when you’re inside a building 
[/list]

-

notes.title: Developer Update 2024 Vol.6
notes.content:
Hello Hunters, 

Looks like something is lurking just around the corner 👀. It’s a new update! [b]Update 0.52[/b] will be landing early next week and we can’t wait to share it with you!

As revealed in our updated roadmap, Update 0.52 will be bringing you a taste of the new Weapon Skills System that we’ve been hard at work on. A whopping 24 new Weapon Skills and gun types will be arriving in ZERO Sievert next week and they only get better the more you use them! 

As always, we will have a full list of patch notes detailing everything included on release. For now, here’s some highlights of what’s to come. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/200f9ba31d9340691c5e62814ee620a9d4363008.png[/img]
[i][b]24 New Weapon Skills[/b][/i] and gun types will be added to ZERO Sievert and these will be replacing the legacy gun skills. We believe it will add a really immersive and dynamic playstyle to the game. For now, we’ll highlight some of the ones we are really excited about!

[b]Close Quarters Training[/b]
Minimum effective ranges are no issue anymore with the new [b]Close Quarters Training[/b] as this skill reduces the minimum effective range of a weapon by 40%! This could also be great for those hunting trips when you don’t want to carry a short-range secondary weapon. 
[i][b]Weapon classes applicable:[/b][/i] Assault Rifles Tier 2, DMRs Tier 2, Sniper Rifles Tier 3

[b]Fast Focus[/b] 
Speed is your middle name with the [b]Fast Focus[/b] skill. Hover over the target with the cursor to make the cross-hair shrink more quickly. 
[i][b]Weapon classes applicable:[/b][/i] SMGs Tier 1, Assault Rifles Tier 1, DMRs Tier 1, Sniper Rifles Tier 1

[b]Marksmen Awareness[/b] 
Shout out to our Hunters who love a good snipe but hate the restriction, we’ve created the perfect skill for you! When using a weapon while scoped, you will be able to partially see the area beyond the reticle interface, while the cross-hair will also be instantly visible. 
[i][b]Weapons classes applicable:[/b][/i] DMRs Tier 1, Sniper Rifles Tier 1

[b]Penetrating Shot[/b] 
Mobs have no chance against you now, as a killing shot will result in the bullet continuing on its path to hit a target behind the first enemy!
[i][b]Weapons classes applicable[/b][/i]: SMGs Tier 3, Shotguns Tier 3, Assault Rifles Tier 3, DMRs Tier 3, Sniper Rifles Tier 3

[b]Reload Artist: Speed Reload[/b]
Bullets go brr with this skill! Double-pressing the reload button will speed up the reload process of magazine-fed weapons. However, any ammunition already in the magazine will be lost.
[i][b]Weapon classes applicable:[/b][/i] Pistols Tier 2, SMGs Tier 1, Shotguns Tier 2, Assault Rifles Tier 1, DMRs Tier 2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/a081028ab51ef61abaee138f292cbe7d3e554c8b.gif[/img]

-

We’ve also implemented some other features and implemented various bug fixes that have been niggling the community. Full list of details will be revealed in next week’s patch notes. 

Just a note: This will be our last major update before 1.0 Launch. Here is the roadmap we shared, if you haven’t seen it already!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/c5cd860ad9c3fbd84b851f9584cede1dccdf12fb.png[/img]

A big thank you to the community for your patience and support for ZERO Sievert during this early access period. We continuously welcome feedback, so make sure to join the ZERO Sievert official Discord to share any thoughts with us! 

Until next week, stay safe out there hunters!

-

notes.title: Update 0.51 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Hunters,

We’re excited to announce that 0.51 is now live! Just make sure to update your game and then you can continue your journey through Zakov. 

As we mentioned in our dev blog last week, this update will bring some much awaited quality of life features to the game and over 40 bugs squashed - ones we know have been especially frustrating the community. 

Without any delay, let’s get into the patch notes!

[b]Patch Notes 0.51[/b]
In this patch, the devs worked on Quality of Life improvements with a focus on bug fixes, additional controller support and localisation updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/8bf329f92c5c084bbd28c5046ed712b9b6e4813a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New radial menu - Controller mapping added for close-up of equipped weapon, weapon torch on/off and weapon laser on/off. Also updated for Steam Deck
[*] New difficulty setting under Settings -> Gameplay, to change the min and max ranges of guns
[*] Alt-tabbing to pause the game has been removed. This has resolved multiple problems with the trade menu while tabbed out but players need to remember that if they want to pause the game before tabbing, it needs to be done manually
[*] Placeholder logos removed
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/6c72d9790e1bd9245df35d22f47ba5cdbb88f56c.png[/img]
[b]Quest[/b]
[list]
[*] ‘Eliminate the Spy’ quest fix; Vlasov will always spawn until the player has taken the dog tag
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Player carry weight now displayed accurately on Trade menus
[*] Igor’s name is now visible in the quest objects for ‘The Old Man’ quest
[*] Quest text can now be fully scrolled from the PDA
[*] Doctor and Conductor’s task option removed as no tasks are available
[*] The date is no longer displayed on the PDA
[*] Daily task objective to defeat Lazar is now showing the correct information in the task description
[*] Joel now presents dialogue text when asked about his faction
[/list]
[b]General Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Extraction points and Points of Interest being inaccessible should be fixed across the board (excluding lesser buildings like houses in the Forest). Because the frequency of this issue is low compared to the possible number of maps that can be created, please continue to raise any time an extraction zone or point of interest is inaccessible so we can investigate further
[/list]
[b]Crash Fix[/b]
[list]
[*] When using a controller to move items from the player inventory to the Trade menu and then minimising the game with Alt+Tab, it caused the player inventory to become inaccessible. This is now fixed
[*] Crash fixed when quick moving an item to Trade menu
[*] Crash fixed when the player uses the crafting table
[/list]
[b]Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*] Modded weapons that are equipped now show applied mods after pressing Alt + Tab
[*] Ammo no longer disappears from a weapon when pressing Alt + Tab during reload
[*] Loading a weapon with a different ammo type whilst the player inventory is full will now cause the initial loaded ammo to be stored on the ground
[*] NPCs now don’t react to players aiming at them when no weapon is equipped
[*] Killing a friendly NPC with a grenade will now trigger nearby NPCs to attack
[/list]
[b]Trading[/b]
[list]
[*] Trading price modifiers now function
[*] Trading Price settings are now applied for all items
[*] When selecting to buy any bulk items from Mr. Junk, items now stack in the Trade window
[*] Items no longer disappear from the player inventory & stash after pressing Alt + Tab
[*] When items are moved to the buying window from the trader’s inventory and the player presses Alt + Tab, the item now reverts back to the trader’s inventory
[*] Items are no longer removed from the inventory when pressing Alt + Tab while in the Trade window
[/list]
[b]Items[/b]
[list]
[*] Items within the player stash no longer duplicate after using the sort functions and Alt + Tab
[*] Injectors now always apply the stat changes mentioned in the tooltip
[*] Barman’s free equipment can now only be acquired once.
[*] Touchscreen no longer shows keyboard and mouse controls on Steam Deck
[*] Mouse cursor and input removed on the Hunt end screen on Steam Deck
[*] Daily Quests do not reappear if removed in the PDA
[*] Map generation in the Train Station proximity on the Makeshift Camp map fixed
[/list]
[b]Controller[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved controller input for selecting task rewards
[*] Exit/Close button on the weapon mod menu is now highlighted when accessed via a controller
[*] Player can now become unstuck when using a controller
[*] Now able to select items in food crafting menu when using controller
[*] Fixed visual stutter when quick moving items to the Trade window when using a controller
[*] You can now exit the teleport menu when using a PlayStation controller
[*] Radial Wheel can no longer be opened during death sequence
[/list]
[b]Localisation[/b]
[list]
[*] Text headers now display correctly across all the supported languages when starting a new save
[*] Quest giver text when viewing an accepted quest on the PDA now shows correctly in all supported languages
[*] Analyzer objectives from Scientist Work 1 and 2 in the PDA now show correctly in all supported languages
[*] When selecting a quest, the experience/rouble text in the top left of the screen now displays correctly Also, when retrieving the reward for a completed task, it will show experience/roubles text correctly at the bottom right of the screen
[*] Extraction points now display correctly across all the supported languages
[*] Localisation text now displays correctly when the player chooses to join the Green Army or the Crimson Corp
[/list]
[b]Latin American[/b]
[list]
[*] Text is now readable and not overlapping the bars when hovering over repair kits and attachments
[/list]
Thank you as always for all your ongoing feedback, they have been pivotal in continuously improving ZERO Sievert! If you have any feedback you want to also submit, the best place for you to do so is on the official ZERO Sievert Discord Server. 

Now it’s time to get back to hunting!

☣️ Join the community on [url=https://t.co/bPaW7oUElW]Discord[/url]
☣️ Subscribe to our [url=http://eepurl.com/hWuO85]Newsletter[/url]

notes.title: Developer Update 2024 Vol.5
notes.content:
Hello Hunters, 

Our next update [b]0.51[/b] is on its way and arriving early next week!

As revealed in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1782120?emclan=103582791470840881&emgid=4202502468835666073]updated road map[/url], 0.51 focuses heavily on bringing major [b]Quality of Life[/b] features to the game that will improve and hopefully maximise your gameplay experience. We’ve also squashed a lot of those pesky bugs that we know have been immensely frustrating whilst you’ve been out exploring Zakov. 

The full list of patch notes will be available next week, but let’s take a peek at a few of the highlights included in this patch. 

We’ve added a new feature in the gameplay settings that will now allow you to change the minimum and maximum range of your guns relative to their base setting. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/8bf329f92c5c084bbd28c5046ed712b9b6e4813a.png[/img]
We’ve added a new feature in the gameplay settings that will now allow you to change the minimum and maximum range of your guns relative to their base setting. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/935ec7757e1c7474ef0eb9e0f7fff76381ec3fff.png[/img]
There has been a lot of feedback related to the gun gameplay since 0.40, which we really appreciate and have been continuously working through. We hope this new slider will alleviate some of your frustrations towards the shooting mechanics and offer you a brand new way to tailor your experience in ZERO Sievert. We are also still working on the new skill system and weapon-based levelling system to bring you an even more gratifying weapon experience. More details on this will be coming soon!

We’ve also removed the ability to pause the game when Alt-tabbing. This has resolved many of the issues the community we’re facing when Alt-tabbing (in the trade menu in particular). In light of this new change, [b]please remember that if you want to pause the game before tabbing, to do so manually. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/6c72d9790e1bd9245df35d22f47ba5cdbb88f56c.png[/img]
We’ve managed to squash over 40 bugs for this particular update but wanted to quickly highlight some of the ones that have been obstructing optimal gameplay. 

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Extraction points and Points of Interest being inaccessible should be fixed across the board (excluding lesser buildings like houses in the Forest). 
[*] Trading price modifiers now function and price settings are now applied for all items. 
[*] Daily Quests do not reappear if removed in the PDA
[/list]
[b]Inventory Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Ammo no longer disappears from a weapon when pressing Alt + Tab during reload
[*] Items no longer disappear from the player inventory & stash after pressing Alt + Tab
[*] Items are no longer removed from the inventory when pressing Alt + Tab while in the Trade window
[/list]
We’ve also fixed various controller related issues, crash occurrences and various localisation text issues. These are just to name a few and as mentioned the full list of details will be revealed in next week’s patch notes. 

Here is the updated road map we also shared last time for those that missed it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/c5cd860ad9c3fbd84b851f9584cede1dccdf12fb.png[/img]
As always, thank you for your ongoing patience and support for ZERO Sievert. Your continuous feedback has been pivotal in improving the game’s ongoing development and if you haven’t already make sure to join our [url=https://t.co/bPaW7oUElW]Discord[/url] as this is the best place to provide feedback. 

We hope you are looking forward to next week’s release, but until then, stay safe hunters!

notes.title: Hotfix: 0.50.3 now available
notes.content:
Today we've released the planned 0.50.3 patch to the game, which fixes the issue around some mission objective quest text that was missing.

We're aware that there are still some instances where quest text isn't fully appearing as intended, although in these cases the objective locations should still be visible once you take the train to the relevant map.

We expect this to be fixed in 0.51, which is due towards the end of July, and is the build the team is now working on. Happy Hunting!

notes.title: Hotfix: 0.50.2 now available
notes.content:
As mentioned last week, we've now updated to 0.50.2 which fixes the issue of losing stashed items when upgrading the hideout.

We now have build 0.50.3 in testing which includes a fix for some of the mission objectives that are missing text since 0.50, and we're aiming to release that later this week.

With those two key issues fixed, focus will turn back to the ongoing work for the Quality of Life patch 0.51, which will aim to fix a number of lower priority (but still irritating!) issues that have been accumulating, and we're intending to include some controller and UI updates, all being well. A full list of patch notes will be available then 0.51 releases, which we still expect to be later in July, as laid out in the last devblog.

I know we say 'thank you for all your patience and support etc' at the end of most messages, but we really do mean that. The [b]whole ZERO Sievert team really appreciates[/b] the ongoing feedback and bug reporting.

notes.title: Update 0.50 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello Hunters,

The time has come - the first update for [b]0.50 is now live![/b] This update will be bringing localisation to the game and is something we’ve been eagerly working on and are excited to welcome new players to experience ZERO Sievert!  

We’ve also tackled several bugs reported by our community and are aware of some known issues that still need addressing - please bear with us as we work on fixing them. If you do happen to experience any other issues/bugs with this release, please do let us know. The best place to report this is in the official [url=https://t.co/bPaW7oUElW]ZERO Sievert discord server[/url]. 

Before we get into the patch notes, let’s also take a moment to look at what the future looks like for Zakov, with our new road map!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/c5cd860ad9c3fbd84b851f9584cede1dccdf12fb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/8bf329f92c5c084bbd28c5046ed712b9b6e4813a.png[/img]
[b]New Languages Available:
[/b][list]
[*] Chinese (simplified)
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] German
[*] Spanish (ES)
[*] Spanish (Latam)
[*] Brazilian Portuguese 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/6c72d9790e1bd9245df35d22f47ba5cdbb88f56c.png[/img]
Over 100 issues have been tackled since 0.40. A small sampling of some of the issues the team have tackled since the last update include:
Implemented Steam Deck and controller revisions to improve player experience - further improvements are in the works.
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where equipped items were disappearing on using Alt+Tab after buying/selling an item to a Trader
[*] Fixed a bug where opening and closing the Trade menu in quick succession would crash the game
[*] Fixed a crash that would occur during Inventory Sort options after using Alt+Tab
[*] Fixed a crash which occurred when adjusting the in-game language and then attempting to load a previous save
[*] Fixed a crash which occurred when the user joins a second faction
[*] Fixed a bug where Crimson Corp/ Green Army could not be joined
[*] Fixed a crash that would occur when scrapping items placed on selling slots from the trader's menu
[*] Fixed a bug where user's items could be placed in the trader's inventory
[*] Fixed a bug user's items could be rebought if they're placed in trader's selling slots
[*] Fixed a bug where weapons could be crafted in the "Mod Weapons" tab after ALT+TAB
[*] Fixed a bug where purchased items which exceed a stack capacity could disappear
[*] Fixed a bug where items can disappear from trader inventory when they are selected and the trading window is full
[*] Fixed a bug where NPC Dialogue' string was displayed after various NPC text options
[*] Fixed a bug where split items could be removed from the inventory after using Alt+Tab
[*] Fixed a bug where Steam Deck Text tips which extended across multiple lines would overlap with loading screen text
[*] Fixed a bug where items can be placed over the Trader inventory via a controller
[*] Fixed a bug where you were unable to scroll credits unless tapping screen on Steam Deck
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/2252aed6b2d71c07d1d32bedd4d96a77fc5f543d.png[/img]
[list][*] Some areas of the game that will be getting future updates have yet to be translated. If you do find untranslated text, please report this to us so we can make sure this is the case.
[*] Players may experience issues with controller when in the inventory and there is more than 1 slot being taken up by the item
[*] Players may experience missing items and misaligned items when playing with controller 
[*] Most Alt+Tab issues have now been fixed, however there may be instances where issues could still occur. To combat this we would advise to not repeatedly use ALT+tab too often.
[*] Moving items to sell and then pressing Alt+tab and then opening the trade window again may still remove the item from the inventory. - Once the trade window has been closed and reopened again, the items will reappear.
[*] Aware of a crash that can occur when minimising/resuming game and using a crafting station with multiple inputs.
[*] Equipped armour can become permanently applied to the player. 
[*] Game runs at a reduced speed when the Frame Limit is capped at 30 FPS on Steamdeck. - We suggest you don’t do this to combat the issue 
[*] Cloud saves involving your syncing to other devices need further investigation.
[*] Game has a placeholder splash screen during the boot up sequence on Steam Deck. [/list]
These known issues will be in the pipeline for [b]update 0.51[/b] - which we are already working on alongside a plethora of other quality of life updates for you, estimated for release in [b]early July[/b]. 

Continuously improving ZERO Sievert based on your feedback is a priority to us, so thank you so much for all your feedback and definitely keep the reports coming!

As always, Happy Hunting!

notes.title: Developer Update 2024 Vol.4
notes.content:
Greetings Hunters, 

We’ve been listening to all your feedback and concerns about the state of the game since releasing our first 0.50 dev blog and want to take a moment to be open with you. 

First and foremost, we want to express our wholehearted gratitude for your ongoing patience. We completely understand your frustrations and realise it has been some time since our last major content drop. 

The main reason behind this is that we were hoping to deliver a nice surprise for you in ZERO Sievert, in the form of co-op multiplayer. As a feature that's been requested often since the game launched in Early Access, we spent a number of months working to investigate the possibility - we also thought it would be really cool to head out hunting with a friend or two alongside. As this hope progressed, we ultimately realised that due to ZERO Sievert originally being designed as a single-player experience, we would need to rewrite a large portion of the game's foundation - and with the months ticking by, we decided it was better to close that chapter of development and instead focus back on what was originally planned for 1.0.

We know that this conclusion will come as a disappointment to many of you and we hope you understand that while it did result in us being quieter (and for a longer time) than we originally wanted to be, we spent that time on something we thought would really improve the end result. Your continued enthusiasm for ZERO Sievert and its future is incredibly valued and we want to express our heartfelt appreciation for your patience during this time and our sincere apologies. 

What that does mean, however, is that we're back to being fully-focused on the original path to releasing from Early Access.

So - what is next?

[b]1.0 IS COMING IN 2024![/b]
First of all, we are beyond excited to share that 1.0 will be coming this Autumn. Since moving away from multiplayer plans, we've been full steam ahead and have some great content planned for launch. We will be sharing more of our plans and roadmaps soon so that you can follow our journey towards 1.0... and beyond!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/c674ef510bd1d42abdfb5856fd89fc301ffc2bb8.png[/img]
[b]CHANGES TO 0.50[/b]
With that small announcement out of the way, Luca has also been hard at work finalising the late-game content for ZERO Sievert, and because the City Map is quite an important part of that, we've chosen to build that map (and what it leads to...) into the 1.0 release instead of releasing it in 0.50. The late-game plans for ZERO Sievert have evolved since we originally spoke about a new map coming in 0.50 patch, therefore it was structurally quite tricky to split out what we originally envisaged for the City Map from the way the game’s storyline was going to reach its conclusion.  

We're not going to spoil what that actually means... but we do think it will be something worth waiting for. However, we did want to share a little sneak peek of what we have been working on in the last couple of months, so here's a little teaser for you!

[previewyoutube=_W33ctnqbAU;full][/previewyoutube]
0.50 will also now be brought to you in multiple phases (0.50, 0.51 and 0.52). This means that we can keep bringing you new updates and get as much feedback from you and veteran testers to make any crucial changes to 1.0 from your direct input.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/78498a97729ee03350d8b33a442c63845937af86.png[/img]
[b]LOCALISATION (0.50 currently planned for June 2024)[/b]
One of the other things we've refocused on since moving away from multiplayer is the long-awaited (and frankly overdue) addition of new languages into the game. We know that lots of you have been asking for this for a very long time, so we're glad to be able to welcome new players to the ZERO Sievert community with the following languages:

[list]
[*] Chinese (simplified)
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] German
[*] Spanish (ES)
[*] Spanish (Latam)
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[/list]
[b]QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATES (0.51 currently planned for July 2024)[/b]
Some improvements to the gameplay based on your feedback - a list of what this will include will come nearer the time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/200f9ba31d9340691c5e62814ee620a9d4363008.png[/img]
[b]SKILLS SYSTEM (starting in 0.52, currently planned for August 2024)[/b]
The code for the foundation of the Skills system has been written. Currently the focus is on veteran (closed beta) feedback, so we can take in all suggestions and further improve these skills to create a really immersive and dynamic playstyle. August will be when we are planning to launch these into the wild.

Something we can share with you today is how the skills system will come in 3 main parts:

[b]Gun Mastery Passives[/b] 
The more you use a gun the better it will become. Different types of guns (pistol, smg etc) will have the chance to improve in different ways.

[b]Gun Mastery Skills[/b]
As you improve your playtime with a specific gun there are slots where you’ll be able to select a skill for that gun.

[b]Hunter Skills[/b]
These Hunter Skills will be able to be picked from a skill tree. These skills focus on the survivability of the character and how they traverse the brutal world of ZERO Sievert. For example, these skills may help the player scavenge more loot, stay alive longer, or overcome situations in a non-aggressive way. 

Our aim is really to enable you to customise your playstyle how you want, so that whether you're a silent sniper-type or a raging gung-ho maniac you'll have something to help you perfect your approach.

At this point we'd really like to thank our Veteran/Beta testing team, who are going to be helping us sense-check a (very) early build - but we can't wait to get this out to our whole community and see what you think! 

We hope you are excited about all the things that are on the way to you soon - 0.52 is currently the last game update we are planning before 1.0 launches! Thank you again for your continued support for ZERO Sievert and utmost patience during the development of our Early Access title.
