notes.title: Mayday! Mayday! Mayday! New challenge mode! 🚨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/1927345f464af288b34eb23519e52fc26152fd74.jpg[/img]

💥MAY DAY! MAY DAY!💥

Hunters, It’s time to suit up and prepare yourself for battle because [b]Mayday Madness[/b] has just landed in ZERO Sievert! 

In this exclusive event, ZERO Sievert won’t be the same place you once explored. We’ve added even more infestations, more hostile NPCs and tougher enemies, but in return you’ll find all chests & bodies will have double the loot, gain double EXP for every kill and 40% chance to spawn an airdrop!  🔫

Are you ready to step up to the challenge? 

Rest assured, there is also an option to opt out of this event if you are a casual or new player and just want to enjoy ZERO Sievert in the normal mode. 

🔫 [b]May Day Event Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ghouls and infestations will spawn at random positions on all maps.
[*] More NPCs on all maps
[*] Tougher enemies (Higher tier NPCs will spawn more frequently)

Now start gearing up because it’s time to RAID!

notes.title: Developer Q&A - Patch 0.50
notes.content:
Hey Hunters! 

Thank you for all the questions you submitted this week for our Developer Q&A, we we're so positively overwhelmed with the response you had to our 0.50 Dev Blog and are excited to finally answer some of your burning questions.

Let's get into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/d1f8c162444bd1a90311fd68399ae42de12a1ec3.png[/img]

[b]Are there going to be new enemies or anomalies implemented in the new map?[/b] 
[i]Yes, the new map will introduce new formidable foes that you’ve never encountered before. For now, we’re looking to add at least 2-3 new bosses into the new map and we’re excited to see how you’ll handle them! 

In terms of anomalies, there are also plans to add map specific ones to the game.[/i]

[b]Will the new enemies have different attacks and mechanics?[/b]
[i]Yes! The new enemies we are currently working on will have new designs and unique attack patterns.[/i]

[b]Any new weapons planned?[/b]
[i]There are no specific plans for new weapons to be added in 0.50, however as mentioned in the dev blog we’re completely overhauling the skill system which will see new weapon playstyles come to light. The new weapon-based levelling system will be based on kills acquired while using specific weapon types (not doing damage etc, only kills) and would offer the player incremental bonuses that make them more effective with their weapon categories of choice.[/i]

[b]What is happening with Multiplayer?[/b]
[i]Currently, we don’t have any updates to share about whether Multiplayer will be part of the final game, but we are still listening to all your feedback on this.[/i] 

[b]Will there be any new lore that comes with the New map?[/b]
[i]With the new map, there will of course be new areas to discover and new enemies to challenge. This map is the start of the new environment, where you’ll start to uncover how the world of Zero Sievert truly came to formation.[/i] 

[b]Are there going to be additional quests added?[/b]
[i]Once the new map is completed we intend to add new quests for you to enjoy, however these may be developed after the map is released and not specifically available on 0.50. If anything changes we will definitely update you along the way![/i]

[b]Will there be mod support?[/b]
[i]There is currently no official mod support for Zero Sievert, but we are listening to all your feedback on this.[/i]

[b]Will any guns be getting buffs or nerfs? i.e Shotguns seem quite weak[/b]
[i]There are no plans at this moment to implement any buffs or nerfs to any of the current weapons in the game, however the new weapon mastery levels we are planning to bring to 0.50 should provide players a fresh take on the current weapons in the game.[/i]

[i]For instance, there will be major and minor mastery perks at specific points along each mastery track, allowing you to gain extra effects that make your weapons more effective / more options with a given weapon type.[/i]

[b]Will there be any black market system implemented into the game?[/b]
[i]No black market system is in the works at the moment.[/i] 

[b]Are there any plans to add more factions into Zero Sievert?[/b]
[i]There are currently no plans to add new factions into Zero Sievert.[/i]

[b]Will cooking be overhauled in some way? In my experience, the general consensus is that it isn't worth the hassle.[/b]
[i]There are currently no plans to change the current cooking system in Zero Sievert, however we will continue to take on board your feedback on this for future updates.[/i] 

[b]Are there any plans to add voice lines to the NPCs?[/b]
[i]We currently have no plans to add voice lines to Zero Sievert.[/i]

[b]Will you be sharing a road map at all?[/b]
[i]We plan to share another road map down the line, but in the meantime we are going to keep you updated via our on-going dev blogs, so stay tuned.[/i]

[b]Are there any planned tweaks for weather or new types of weather?[/b]
[i]No new weather conditions are planned at the moment.[/i] 

[b]When are we expecting to see the 0.50 release?[/b]
[i]We are so glad that you are excited about everything we’ve revealed so far on update 0.50, however we don’t have a specific date yet on when this will be released. Rest assured, we will be regularly updating the community as the update develops, so stay tuned![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/d1f8c162444bd1a90311fd68399ae42de12a1ec3.png[/img]

As always, if you have any more questions about 0.50 do pop them down below or join the official Zero Sievert [url=https://t.co/bPaW7oUElW]Discord[/url] where you should be able to interact directly with the community!

Happy Hunting!

notes.title: Developer Update 2024 Vol.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/5ea2f13e4132e9c5d84e699f8c4ed64ca43cce53.jpg[/img]

[i] [quote] Greetings Hunters!

Have you been scavenging the brutal nuclear wasteland and fighting off those pesky ghouls on the controller since we introduced it in update 0.41?

Well it’s time to brace yourself and reach newer heights because we've got some updates that we’re super eager to share with you today and know you’ve been anticipating. 

We have a lot more intricate details to share with you soon on everything coming in 0.50 so definitely stay tuned for these updates. For now, we hope you’re excited and prepared to experience ZERO Sievert on another level knowing what is to come!

On that note, we want to sign this dev blog off by thanking all of our Hunters for all the support, patience, and feedback you have given us over the past few months! The game could not have reached such heights of success without each and everyone one of you. Let’s not keep you waiting, and enjoy a sneak peek into some new developments that will dawn Zero Sievert soon...[/quote] [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/4a776115763d261f8b440f12f3205d2ed1aa4aa2.png[/img]

Yes, it’s the moment you’ve all been waiting for, a new map is well on its way to Zero Sievert! We’re still fleshing out all the intricate details of this new terrain, but for now think high-rise buildings, dark tunnels and abandoned automobiles.👀

This is going to be our biggest map yet. As you traverse this uncharted territory, you’ll come face to face with even more challenges and formidable foes you’ve never encountered before!

We’ll be unveiling more news about the new map in the coming weeks and months, so stay tuned and in the meantime start brushing up on your hunting skills in preparation! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/78498a97729ee03350d8b33a442c63845937af86.png[/img]

Languages are boarding the train and making their way to Zero Sievert!

We really appreciate the demand from our local and international fans for the implementation of languages, so we are delighted to bring these five to you in 0.50. Just a note: The game won't be localised again until 1.0 due to bandwidth. 

Game will be localised into:
[list]
[*] Chinese (simplified)
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] German
[*] Spanish (Castillian)
[*] Brazilian Portuguese[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/200f9ba31d9340691c5e62814ee620a9d4363008.png[/img]

We want players to feel engaged and excited about the skill system and character progression in Zero Sievert. We believe that the current structure does not reflect our overall vision. Some of the skills currently in the game can be quite imbalanced and can reduce the combat difficulty of the game. Therefore, we are doing a complete rework of the skill system structure to alleviate these issues, whilst also raising the quality bar of the system as a whole, making progression in the game more immersive and satisfying.

There are two main focus points we are going to tackle in the new skill system:
[list][*] Add more interesting skills and perk opportunities for you to diversify the way you can play and progress in Zero Sievert.
[*] Make levelling more rewarding - we want you to feel excited when you reach the next level.[/list]
We’ll have more in-depth details to share very soon on how we aim to implement these focus points into the game, but for now here’s some new things you can expect to see: 

[h3]Weapon-based Levelling system[/h3]

Our overall design direction for Zero Sievert is to refine the weapon dynamics for future designs. We want the shooting system to be more rewarding for the player when they choose the right weapon for the right situation. 

Introducing a new weapon-based levelling system! This will be centred around the different weapon categories and you will be able to gain weapons mastery levels based on kills acquired while using each specific weapon type and earn weapon skill bonuses that should provide a more gratifying weapon experience. 

[h3]New Perk System[/h3]

Levelling up your Hunter Rank now comes with perks! Perks are special buffs that you will be able to unlock using perk points, a resource you’ll be awarded each time you level-up your esteemed hunter rank. Each perk will offer a unique boon / special effect that becomes active as soon as it’s unlocked. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/d1f8c162444bd1a90311fd68399ae42de12a1ec3.png[/img]

See you in the next dev blog and as always, Happy Hunting!

notes.title: Update 0.41.18 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/0617c5ff81702e6e07358ce26b8368159ff4c128.png[/img]

Hunters,

We're rolling out a new patch for ZERO Sievert, and we truly appreciate your patience and support during the wait. This patch is focusing on bug fixes and implementing top feedback from players who use controllers. Here's the detailed list:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/8bf329f92c5c084bbd28c5046ed712b9b6e4813a.png[/img]
[h2]New Feature[/h2]
[list]
[*] Quick Inventory Transfer on Controller: The cursor will now snap to the closest item when transferring items between inventories, instead of following the item moved to the other inventory.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/6c72d9790e1bd9245df35d22f47ba5cdbb88f56c.png[/img]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where quick-selecting items to a complete stack could greatly increase inventory weight.
[*] Fixed a bug where stat info for equipped weapon mods was not displayed.
[*] Fixed a bug showing debug text in the tooltip during the "Old Man" quest.
[*] Fixed a bug where debug text was shown in the tooltip for the "I've helped you dock" message.
[*] Fixed a bug where various menus could not be closed with ESC if the first in-game interaction was done via a controller.
[*] Fixed a crash occurring when consuming an item while it was in the sell window.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing the completion of Scientist Work daily quests.
[*] Fixed a bug where guns and armours could reach negative durability levels.
[*] Fixed a bug where weapons bought from vendors would drop to negative durability after firing a couple of rounds.
[*] Fixed a bug where inventory capacity did not update until the panel was reopened.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing players from equipping and viewing stats on unequipped weapon attachments.
[*] Fixed a bug showing all quests with the Barman as the quest giver.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented stackable items from combining into a stack when quick-transferring.
[*] Fixed instances of incorrect quest tracking when using an old save.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game difficulty resets upon closing the game.
[*] Fixed weapon overlap in the mod weapons screen when the window is full. It now prevents additional items from appearing and prioritises player inventory - meaning if you move a weapon from your stash to your inventory, the panel will prioritise displaying it.
[*] Fixed overlapped items present when placing equipped items on top of inventory items.
[*] Fixed a bug causing overlap in inventory when removing a weapon modification.
[/list]
[h3]Controller[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when pressing L1 on a fresh launch with any PlayStation controller.
[*] Fixed a crash on launch with a Nintendo Switch Pro Controller connected.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.41 Live NOW | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/0617c5ff81702e6e07358ce26b8368159ff4c128.png[/img]

Hunters, 

The moment has arrived! Update 0.41 is now live, and with it comes a couple of new features that we've been eagerly working on. Here’s what you can jump into right now:

[previewyoutube=YN0tFfx72uU;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/8bf329f92c5c084bbd28c5046ed712b9b6e4813a.png[/img]
[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
[list]
[*] Grab your gamepads! Controller support has officially landed. 
[h3]Mapping[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/3f94839b9b0323178002795128dce04802de0836.jpg[/img]
[*] You might need to adjust your controller settings in the Steam 'Controller' tab, ensuring it's set to "per game override." [b]This is particularly important if you've previously tweaked Steam's controller settings to get gamepads working, as it may conflict with the official gamepad support.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/e8ee0967a3df104f77477dc95647ed728fc5ffb7.png[/img]
[*] Take ZERO Sievert with you on [b]Steam Deck[/b]. It is fully playable, and we're currently working on full Deck verification.
[/list]
[h2]UI Functionality Overhaul[/h2]
[list]
[*] We've introduced a significant overhaul to the UI, enhancing not only the look but also the functionality, making it more intuitive and efficient for all players. This update also includes extensive backend changes as we pave the way for potential future features.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/a87fd3f05d4ccd1c0db2229a5494f2416a0753cb.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/a7859b4ddb0a34ddbc107b68ca79b90b6da57a97.png[/img]
[h2]Inventory Sorting[/h2]
[list]
[*] One of the most requested features by all of you – quick inventory sorting is here. Now you can spend more time on killing and looting. 
[*] [b]We've heard you on the need for stash sorting – it's on its way in the very next hotfix![/b]
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/0aea06b9b02086f911cbce9a6c299c1b2328d29a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/168955f7471e2446ac4282209b4901a9b4ef21bf.png[/img]
[h2]AI Weapon Recoil[/h2]
[list]
[*] AI combat just got more realistic. Enemies will now deal with weapon recoil – the battle is now fairer, which also implies high-tier enemies are (a lot) better at handling their guns than your ordinary road bandits.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/7218c865d177713b14933aadf66b9fa69718c33c.png[/img]
[h2]Feedback for 0.41[/h2]
[list]
[*] With the major backend overhauls in 0.41, we’ve ironed out as many issues as we could. However, if you stumble upon any oddities, please let us know through the usual channels ([url=https://discord.com/channels/796723961975013386/1022504219644792852]Bug Report[/url] / [url=https://discord.com/channels/796723961975013386/1022505147332571186]Feedback[/url] / [url=https://discord.com/channels/796723961975013386/1022505448491978904]Feature Request[/url] / [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1782120/discussions/]Steam Forum[/url]). Rest assured, we're on standby to squash any bugs and polish your experience.
[/list]
We're very grateful for the support and feedback from our community, as always. And we cannot wait to share with you all the amazing new BIG things that we are baking in the oven. Stay tuned, stay safe in Zakov, and happy hunting!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/3c13f18a1e5e1e3b08a82fb2d6733c33a589e9fc.png[/img]

notes.title: Developer Update 2024 Vol.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/3c13f18a1e5e1e3b08a82fb2d6733c33a589e9fc.png[/img]

Hunters,

As we near the rollout of Update 0.41, we wish to express our deep gratitude for your invaluable feedback and patience. 0.41 is taking a little longer than we originally planned, as we are squashing both big and small bugs. Please bear with us.

[h3]What's coming in 0.41[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]AI Recoil Overhaul[/b]: You've spoken, and we've listened! A pivotal change in this update is the introduction of recoil to AI's weapons. AI enemies will now experience the same recoil mechanics as players, ensuring fairer combat that you've all been requesting. The recoil level is tied to the AI enemies' level; the higher the AI tier, the better their recoil control. This means Lazar will have much better aim than your ordinary bandits. Check out the videos below to see the AI's new recoil dynamics!

[b]Low Tier Enemies[/b]:
[previewyoutube=knDyYUbI_fc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]High Tier Enemies[/b]:
[previewyoutube=8-P5u5amqN4;full][/previewyoutube]

[*] [b]UI & Functionality Overhaul[/b]: This update brings a significant overhaul to the game's UI, with a special focus on enhancing functionality. We're aiming to make the UI more intuitive and efficient for all players, and [b]paving the way for future features like inventory sorting[/b].

[*] [b]Controller Support (and Steam Deck)[/b]: Finally, the much-anticipated controller support arrives, it opens up more ways of [strike]dying in[/strike] enjoying ZERO Sievert. By the way, you can already enjoy ZERO Sievert on Steam Deck while we work on full Deck verification.
[/list]
[h3]What's Coming Next[/h3]

While Update 0.41 marks significant advancements, the excitement doesn't stop here. We're cooking some thrilling content and features for our next major update that promise to electrify you like never before. Stay tuned for more information.

Stay vigilant, and happy hunting in Zakov!

[h3]Side Note[/h3]

If you're interested in being part of closed beta / alpha testing for all exciting current and future Modern Wolf projects including ZERO Sievert, please don't hesitate to reach out to me on Discord (@ericd). Please note that signing an NDA is required if you are selected. We value your insights and look forward to collaborating with our dedicated community!

notes.title: Christmas Update is LIVE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/b929796fe18ccfff7dc9ae786f339547b3d35f9a.png[/img]

[b]Ho-Ho-Ho Hunters![/b]

Get ready for a festive twist in the world of Zakov! This Christmas, we're introducing a special event that will bring both joy and challenge to your scavenging adventures.

[h3]Limited Time Holiday Event[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Santa's Arrival[/b]: Keep your eyes peeled on every map for the jolly red figure. He's making his way through the wasteland, and it's up to you to find him!
[*] [b][spoiler]Milk[/spoiler]for Santa[/b]: Once you locate Santa, you can give him a [spoiler]bottle of milk[/spoiler]. In appreciation of your good-hearted nature, he might gift you an entire sleigh of gifts!
[*] [b]Santa's Sleigh[/b]: Each sleigh of gifts has a chance to contain unique Christmas-themed items, including exclusive armour, Santa’s weapon, and a [b]magic backpack*[/b]. But there's a twist! These magic drops attract attention... Not only are ghouls and bandits interested in Santa’s gifts, but bosses like Kibba or Arman too! So, be prepared (or don’t).
[/list][b]*Enjoy the festivities for now and make the most of the magic. But remember, the enchantment of this special backpack won't last beyond the holiday season![/b]

[h2]Upcoming Features[/h2] 
As we celebrate the festive season, we're also excited to reiterate some of the major features and improvements coming to ZERO Sievert:
[list]
[*] [b]Full Controller Support[/b]: In an upcoming update, we're introducing full controller support, enhancing the game's accessibility and playability for those who prefer using gamepads.
[*] [b]Major UI Functionality Changes[/b]: We're working on a major overhaul of the user interface, aimed at improving functionality, user experience, and accessibility.
[*] [b]Skill System Rework*[/b]: Our comprehensive overhaul of the Skill System and introduction of a New Perk System are set to significantly enhance ZERO Sievert. This rework will add a new layer of diversity to both gameplay and gunplay, allowing for more personalised and tailored experiences.
[/list][b]*Please note that these features are currently a work in progress and subject to change as development progresses.[/b]

We wish all our players happy hunting and a happy holiday in Zakov. Stay alert, stay safe, and may your magic drops be merry and bright!

P.S. Don't forget, we are conducting a daily key giveaway on our [url=https://twitter.com/zerosievert?lang=en-GB]Twitter[/url], and one lucky hunter who answers all 12 questions correctly will win a ZERO Sievert gift box!"

notes.title: Update 0.40.23 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/a3696f912117811915f7766b778d5a78c31deed0.png[/img]

Hunters!

Before we delve into the changes this patch brings us, on top of the imminent arrival of controller support, we're excited to share that we are working on a comprehensive [b]skill system rework[/b], including [b]a new perk system[/b]. This overhaul aims to add substantial diversity to gameplay and gunplay, offering you new ways to tailor your experience in ZERO Sievert. [b]While we can't reveal the specifics or a date just yet, stay tuned for more information.[/b] Your adventures in Zakov are about to get even more thrilling!

As always, we are committed to continuously improving your experience in ZERO Sievert, and in line with this, and thanks to your valuable feedback, we're rolling out a new patch following the major 0.40 update. Here's what's new and what's been fixed:

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/7218c865d177713b14933aadf66b9fa69718c33c.png[/img]
[h3]Major Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies will now panic shoot (start shooting with impaired aim) if the player is chasing them, rather than always running to their weapon's effective range. 
[*] Acid rain will no longer occur at the start of a raid.
[*] General reduction in rain chance during raids. 
[*] Recoil rebalance across all weapon types, with recoil amount now corresponding to weapon categories.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/6c72d9790e1bd9245df35d22f47ba5cdbb88f56c.png[/img]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where experience couldn't exceed 64,999.
[*] Adjusted the pricing for the Ash12 20-round magazine. 
[*] 12.7x55mm ammunition is now included in quest ammo rewards.
[*] Fixed a bug where the cursor would get stuck in the middle of the screen if the player extracted/died while consuming a consumable.
[*] Crimson Corp, Hunter, and ??? factions can now correctly spawn Cyclops troops.
[*] Fixed a crash triggered by right-clicking while throwing a grenade from the inventory. 
[*] Fix a bug where armour didn't take durability damage when bullets were completely blocked.
[*] Fixed a crash when dying in permadeath mode. 
[*] Fixed a bug where BB91 Kerr suppressor is not correctly aligned.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/a5c4dc8c54039c69a96815899e570a0a0ab474c5.png[/img]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced recoil while shooting and aiming with optical scopes. 
[*] Armour durability damage from anomalies is now reduced by half.
[*] Improved Recoil and Ergonomic stats for several EC74 handguards.
[*] Lowered base recoil stats of guns in the EC series (except EC 101).
[*] Further balance tweaks for certain weapons.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update. Don’t forget, [b]your favourite seasonal update is just around the corner![/b] As always, we look forward to your thoughts and feedback on all our channels.

Happy hunting and stay sharp in the wilds of Zakov!




--

[*] Difficulty Presets have been adjusted to achieve parity between the Survivor and Hunter difficulties. The primary difference is that players will lose all equipment upon death on the Hunter difficulty. [*] Enemy now always drops armours on all difficulties.
[*] The number of wolves in each pack has been reduced, although the overall frequency of wolf pack spawns remains unchanged.
[*] HP of Wolves and Ghouls have been reduced for better close-range combat experience.
[*] All preset loadouts now come with a sidearm, as well as a bottle of vodka for tackling early game radiation. We also swapped out a loadout for a tactical operator loadout that comes with flashbangs. They are now revamped to align more closely with various playstyles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/2252aed6b2d71c07d1d32bedd4d96a77fc5f543d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Grenades currently do not damage armour.
[*] Armours will now drop from NPCs regardless of the "NPC Drop Armour" difficulty setting. This change is intentional to ensure that existing game saves benefit from armour drops in line with new changes.
[/list]
[b]Additional Note on Gamepad Support and Steam Deck Compatibility[/b]

As we progress towards full gamepad support, we'd like to inform players using the Steam Deck of potential conflicts with existing custom inputs. This is due to the ongoing implementation of native gamepad support in the game.

To ensure an optimal experience, players with custom input configurations on the Steam Deck may need to experiment and adjust their settings to align with the new work-in-progress gamepad support system.

We understand these adjustments might require extra effort on your part and greatly appreciate your cooperation as we work towards achieving full controller support.

Stay sharp and happy hunting in Zakov!

notes.title: Developer Update 2023 Vol.9 - Clarification on Gunplay Mechanics
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/3c13f18a1e5e1e3b08a82fb2d6733c33a589e9fc.png[/img]

Hello Hunters!

We've been attentively listening to your feedback since releasing the devblog and fully grasp your concerns about weapon effective range. We've realised some outdated information in our previous devblog regarding shooting mechanics, which we've already revised based on early closed beta testers’ feedback. We apologise for any confusion caused.

[h2]Correction on Glancing System and Crosshair Mechanics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Red & Pink Crosshair: [b]A red/pink crosshair indicates a narrower angle for full hits but doesn't solely guarantee glancing hits. Precise shooting can still achieve full hits.[/b] What this means is that in close-range combat with weapons that are not specialised for such range, such as Assault Rifles, you can still achieve a full hit so long as you shoot more accurately. 

Do note that this is not the case for long range weapons such as DMR or Sniper Rifles, as they should not be used for close-range-combat.
[/list]These mechanics were refined based on feedback from our closed beta players during early testing. Our aim is to ensure each gun type has its unique utility, encouraging varied tactical play. Note that this system is accuracy-based, not chance-based.

[h2]Illustration for Better Understanding[/h2]
In the illustrations below, both shots show the angle based on effective range and cursor position (notice the cursor is over the enemy). The red indicates the estimated unit hitbox, while the yellow part of the hitbox shows where a shot needs to hit to be considered a full hit.

[b]Illustration 1[/b]: With a white crosshair indicating full effective range, any hit on the large yellow hitbox area results in a full hit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/43001f0f023361dae0a809568e50be76f0f6bd44.png[/img]

[b]Illustration 2[/b]: With a red crosshair, indicating a range outside full effectiveness, a full hit is achievable by accurately hitting the smaller yellow hitbox area. The yellow hitbox area naturally moves in accordance with your and enemy position. Although challenging, precise shooting can yield full hits. It is actually easier than it looks. This aligns with the new crosshair placement discussed in the previous blog.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/a3da0addb8ea1cb6b7e72b1843bc5e36def169cc.png[/img]

We appreciate your understanding and patience as we continue to refine ZERO Sievert. Your feedback is invaluable in this journey so please keep them coming!

Stay sharp out there!

notes.title: Developer Update 2023 Vol.8 - Elevating Combat to New Heights
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/3c13f18a1e5e1e3b08a82fb2d6733c33a589e9fc.png[/img]

Hunters!

First and foremost, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude for your patience. It's been some time since our last major content drop, and your enduring support has been invaluable (although we do hope you are having fun with those little demons we added during Halloween). As we approach the release of Patch 0.40, featuring "Gunplay 2.0," among other major features, we're not just introducing an update – we're transforming our core gameplay to elevate your combat experience to new heights. This significant upgrade is a testament to our commitment to your immersive experience and tactical prowess in ZERO Sievert. Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping this patch, and we genuinely hope it resonates with your expectations. As always, we're listening and ready to act on your insights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/d1f8c162444bd1a90311fd68399ae42de12a1ec3.png[/img]
[h1]Elevating Combat to New Heights[/h1]

[h2]Introducing Grenades[/h2]
We're infusing new layers of strategy with the addition of grenades, offering you novel ways to engage in combat and control the battlefield. This update introduces a variety of grenades, including:
[list]
[*] Variety of explosive grenades
[*] Flashbangs
[*] Mines[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/ced453c77108f00af311c66af2aac1a1abdf1330.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/f57008f5d1887bb9e578517a878b3693fd5faa4b.png[/img]

All of which will add unprecedented tactical depth to combat. These new tools allow for diverse strategies, giving you more control over the battlefield and enhancing the realism of engagements.

These valuable items are not just powerful, but also rare commodities. You can find them through looting or purchase them from specific vendors. Be aware that these sought-after items may require patience as you might need to wait for vendors to restock. Cherish these assets, as they can turn the tide of any encounter.
 
[h2]Shooting System Overhaul (Gunplay 2.0)[/h2]
It represents a fundamental shift in our combat mechanics, marking a significant evolution in player engagement in battles. The introduction of a glancing system and redefined weapon effective ranges means each weapon type now has a distinct role, tailored for specific situations and encounters. This nuanced approach, coupled with the emphasis on strategic crosshair placement, ensures a more immersive experience and encourages players to thoughtfully consider their loadout and run choices based on the challenges they'll face. [b]These changes are designed to enhance skirmish realism and foster more tactical and varied combat strategies, making the game more challenging yet less punishing, and more complex yet more rewarding.[/b] Also, keep in mind that some changes are tied to future features we have been cooking. We will share more information once we have something solid.

[b]Keep reading for a detailed exploration of these changes as we delve into Gunplay 2.0 later in this article.[/b]
 
[h2]AI Enhancement[/h2]
Certain aspects of enemy AI have been refined to reward tactical movement and positioning. NPCs now also react to you aiming at them.
[list]
[*] [b]Flanking & Enemy Response[/b]: Players will benefit from a revised flanking system that allows for more strategic engagements. Quick repositioning after an attack can catch enemies off-guard, as they now react more slowly to being flanked, especially from behind or at a distance. Conversely, enemies will respond promptly if you attempt to re-engage from the last known position, incentivising varied tactics over repetitive peeks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/2ad338ace690b0888d23cf7ebfc29af3280d89d4.png[/img]
[*] [b]Tactics[/b]: Enemy AI has been fine-tuned for more realistic engagements. Now, enemies will move into the effective range of their weapons before opening fire, and their vertical view distance has been reduced. This adjustment means enemies won't shoot at or show aggression towards players from off-screen, demanding more strategic positioning and awareness from both AIs and players in every encounter.
[/list] 
[h2]Introducing New Enemy Tiers[/h2]
In 0.40, we're introducing a new dimension to combat encounters with the new Enemy Tiers system. Now, the difficulty level of each enemy is visually discernible, as different AI tiers are distinguished by their unique armour, and yes, of course you can loot their armours. On top of that, “Armour drop” option is on by default for all difficulty levels now. 

The more experience players have, the tougher enemies they'll encounter. Each AI tier also comes with a distinct weapon drop pool, adding further variety to your engagements. This change not only adds a visual variety to the adversaries but also enhances strategic decision-making in combat. Players can now quickly assess the challenge level of each enemy and adjust their tactics accordingly. This tier-based system enriches the depth and complexity of encounters, ensuring that each skirmish in Zakov remains engaging and unpredictable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/38227bc14e2f241203b94f590a729678c7e9d861.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/1810292ccd2bb91727e161f1e2b124ed417321e0.png[/img]
[h2]New End Game Faction[/h2]
Prepare to face a formidable new faction that will invariably be hostile towards players. This faction, emerging as a pivotal end-game challenge, is designed to test your survival skills to the fullest. Notably, there are no opportunities for alliance with this faction. [b]They will become a part of your adventure once you unlock the mall area[/b], setting the stage for intense and thrilling encounters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/307934ec0c2df045969ae3793ba64a5db5062f2e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/d3416113a427a8a1937973b4731fd85808060cbb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/e40766ae4ff71cc032acaf812c64e357d29855fb.png[/img]
[h2]Other major additions and improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Loadout Changes[/b]: Loadouts have all received a bit of love, each now coming with a sidearm, as well as a bottle of vodka [strike]for tackling early game radiation[/strike]. We also swapped out a loadout for a tactical operator loadout that comes with flashbangs. All loadouts have been thoughtfully revamped to align more closely with various playstyles, ensuring that each one offers a unique and sensible approach to your adventures in Zakov. Expect further changes in future patches!
[*] [b]New Calibre[/b]: Experience the impact of an entirely new calibre added to our ammunition options.
[*] [b]New Weapons[/b]: Discover six exciting new weapons to enhance your arsenal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/ac31ae46617a61924de330e16332931971a6de66.gif[/img]
[*] [b]New Armours[/b]: Gear up with a range of new armours, each offering unique protection and style.
[*] [b]New Experience Level[/b]: Push your skills further with a new experience level cap beyond “Master.”
[*] [b]New Loading Screens for Each Map[/b]: Delve into each map with a unique visual introduction. Our update brings a new loading screen for every map, enhancing your journey into Zakov with distinct and immersive visuals. Here is a sneak peek at the loading screen of your favourite forest! Big shoutout to [url=https://twitter.com/RomanPStevens]Roman Stevens[/url] for the amazing artwork!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/7503fc2077c5afe30bdfae5810bde6acc1df4e63.png[/img]
[*] [b]Improved Map Generation Time[/b]: Enjoy faster loading times, getting you into the action quicker than ever.
[*] [b]Gameplay[/b]:
[list]
[*] Changed default view distance.
[*] Scopes now increase the maximum view distance.
[*] Repair kits no longer need gunsmith skill levels in order to be crafted.
[/list][*] [b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Difficulty settings have been adjusted to create parity between “survivor” and “hunter”, with “hunter” difficulty now essentially being almost the same, but with the effect of losing your gear when you die.
[*] All player needs refill values from bunker NPCs have had their costs drastically reduced from 4000 roubles (from empty to full replenishment) to 500 roubles to better accommodate early game play.
[/list][*] [b]Emission Changes[/b]: This update offers a reprieve between waves, allowing players to freely move across the map.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/a4a30c06b2bc68f2b087cc233ea87f1f9cfb447c.gif[/img][/list]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/b100d81ba66aa202a6698af297c9207b19c2351f.png[/img]
[h1]Insights into the Shooting System Overhaul[/h1]

[h3]Weapon Effectiveness[/h3] 
We've introduced an 'effective range' for each weapon type, influencing damage based on your cursor placement. This aims to distinguish weapons better and tailor them to specific combat scenarios.

[h3]Hit Outcomes[/h3] 
Shots can result in three types of hits:
[list]
[*] Full Hits (100% damage): Achieved when engaging within a weapon's effective distance with accurate 
[*] Glancing Hits (50% damage): Occur within a weapon's overall range but without precise cursor tracking, or when a weapon is used at suboptimal distances.
[*] Null Hits (0% damage): Happen when attempting to engage outside a weapon's total range, indicated by an 'X' on the crosshair.
[/list]
[h3]Visual Feedback[/h3] 
An enemy's outline will change colour upon being hit – white signifies a full hit, while red indicates a glancing hit. Remember, penetrating enemy armour is still a prerequisite for inflicting damage.

[h3]Crosshair Dynamics[/h3]
The crosshair now provides a visual guide for weapon range effectiveness:
[list]
[*] White: Indicates within effective range, where precise cursor placement will result in full hits.
[*] Red: Indicates within an ineffective range[strike], guaranteeing only glancing hits.[/strike]
[*] Pink: Marks the edge of effective range. Glancing hits are more likely here, indicating you should adjust your position to return to full effective range.
[*][b]Correction: Red & Pink Crosshair: A red/pink crosshair indicates a narrower angle for full hits but doesn't solely guarantee glancing hits. Precise shooting can still achieve full hits.[/b] What this means is that in close-range combat with weapons that are not specialised for such range, such as Assault Rifles, you can still achieve a full hit so long as you shoot more accurately. More explanation [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1782120/view/3873721309648374465]Here[/url]
[*] X Mark: Beyond effective range, resulting in null hits.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/70edff8c33b98097516b6caa22230ad9f3cc4ef1.gif[/img]
[h3]Cursor Placement[/h3]
Crosshair placement is now paramount. More precise weapons require better crosshair placement for full hits. Imprecise weapons, like Shotguns and SMGs are generally more forgiving. Familiarise yourself with each weapon's characteristics for the best combat advantage. That said, placing the crosshair directly on your enemy should always be your goal, you’d better not continue to aim behind an enemy and expect to deal full damage. ([b]We of course still love you!❤️[/b])

Below screenshots demonstrate how your cursor is able to tell you that the F90 is more suited for close-range combat than an EC 74U.

With the F90, your crosshair turns white at close range, indicating it is within its effective range.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/c67335800507b1f9d9c10dc93b30c957f43fe06a.png[/img]
With the EC 74U, your crosshair turns red at close range, indicating it is outside its effective range.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/c8ca470ee6eb89b6c7f7b7094a82d33f8661c312.png[/img]
[h3]Recoil Mechanics[/h3] 
A new recoil system has been added, increasing gun kick but allowing players to counteract this by pulling back towards their character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/eb5f9846390ace0020391ba7723ee04844a56632.gif[/img]

[h3]Gun Rebalancing[/h3] 
All firearms have been adjusted to fit within the new system. Prepare to reacquaint yourselves with your arsenal!

[h3]Change in Weapon Attachments Mechanic[/h3] 
Weapon attachments now affect the weapon's stats by a flat amount, not by a percentage. This adjustment provides a clearer and more predictable impact on weapon performance, aiding players in strategising their equipment choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/7218c865d177713b14933aadf66b9fa69718c33c.png[/img]
[h1]Coming Next[/h1]
As the frosty winds of Christmas approach the rugged landscapes of Zakov, we're gearing up for a festive seasonal event. Your favourite holiday-themed surprises will be back to enhance your survival experience!

Beyond the horizon of Patch 0.40, our journey through Zakov continues to evolve. We're working on integrating full controller support and UI Functionality Changes to enrich your exploration and combat experience. These updates ensure that every Hunter has the best tools at their disposal, setting the stage for the arrival of our next major patch, where even more gameplay features will be introduced. Our aim is to ensure that each major update not only enriches your adventure in ZERO Sievert but also brings forth novel challenges and opportunities. 
 
[h1]A Note on Localisation[/h1]
As one of the most requested features by hunters from all over the world, we understand how important localisation is to our community and want to assure you that it is a key part of our roadmap and will be addressed during the period leading up to our 1.0 release. As a small team, we are working diligently to ensure every aspect of the game meets your expectations. We kindly ask for your patience as we navigate through this process. We appreciate your understanding and support.
 
[h1]Special Note[/h1]
A sincere thank you to all our closed beta testers for your invaluable contributions to ZERO Sievert. Your feedback, insights, and dedication have played a crucial role in shaping the game's development. Your efforts are greatly appreciated by our entire team.

[b]For those interested in participating in future closed beta testing, we welcome your enthusiasm and invite you to reach out to me on Discord (@ericd).[/b] Your involvement could be pivotal in helping us refine and perfect future updates.

Thank you once again for being an essential part of our community's journey.
 
[h1]Final Words[/h1]
Join us for our upcoming preview stream on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/modernw0lf]Twitch[/url] channel on Monday the 4th at 2pm GMT where we'll offer an exclusive sneak peek into the upcoming Patch 0.40. This is your chance to see all the new features and updates in action before they go live. Keep an eye on your favourite content creators too. They'll be diving into the patch, providing their unique takes and insights, further enriching your understanding and anticipation for what's ahead in Zakov. These combined previews are sure to prepare you for the exciting new changes!

So, Hunters, gear up and stay alert! The wilds of Zakov are set to offer new thrills, challenges, and adventures that will test your survival skills and keep you on the edge of your seat.

New Experience Level: Push your skills further with a new experience level cap beyond “Master.”

New Loading Screens for Each Map: Delve into each map with a unique visual introduction. Our update brings a new loading screen for every map, enhancing your journey into Zakov with distinct and immersive visuals. Here is a sneak peek at the loading screen of your favourite forest! Big shoutout to [url=https://twitter.com/RomanPStevens]Roman Stevens[/url] for the amazing artwork!
Improved Map Generation Time: Enjoy faster loading times, getting you into the action quicker than ever.

tags.bug: Repair kits no longer need gunsmith skill levels in order to be crafted.

tags.balance_change: Difficulty settings have been adjusted to create parity between “survivor” and “hunter”, with “hunter” difficulty now essentially being almost the same, but with the effect of losing your gear when you die.
All player needs refill values from bunker NPCs have had their costs drastically reduced from 4000 roubles (from empty to full replenishment) to 500 roubles to better accommodate early game play.

tags.feature: Emission Changes: This update offers a reprieve between waves, allowing players to freely move across the map.
A new recoil system has been added, increasing gun kick but allowing players to counteract this by pulling back towards their character.

tags.balance_change: All firearms have been adjusted to fit within the new system. Prepare to reacquaint yourselves with your arsenal!

Weapon attachments now affect the weapon's stats by a flat amount, not by a percentage. This adjustment provides a clearer and more predictable impact on weapon performance, aiding players in strategising their equipment choices.

tags.feature: We're working on integrating full controller support and UI Functionality Changes to enrich your exploration and combat experience.

notes.title: Beta Branch for Patch 0.31.29
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/92d49f63f2a9595e30206314af258a413bc527fa.png[/img]

Hunters,

Patch 0.31.29 Beta Branch is now available!

We are aware that a minority of players are still having issues with their savegame being wiped each time they start the game. We have nailed it down to a Steam cloud save related issue, and we're launching a new beta branch, version 0.31.29, to try to tackle this matter. [b]This patch is specifically aimed at players who are experiencing Steam Cloud save issues (e.g., save gets deleted each time they launch the game). If you are not experiencing the above-mentioned issues, you do not have to update.[/b]

As always, we're committed to acting on your feedback. Please keep sharing your thoughts; we're truly grateful for every perspective you bring to the table!


[h3]Opt-In Steps[/h3]
[list]
[*] Right Click on ZERO Sievert in your Steam library.
[*] Choose "Properties."
[*] Select the "Betas" tab.
[*] Choose "public-beta - 0.31.29" from the dropdown menu.
[*] Your game should auto-update to 0.31.29.
[/list]
[h3]Adding Launch Options[/h3]

In order to help us fix this issue, we kindly ask you to turn on the below launch options, and [b]send the generated log either to @ericd on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sievert]Discord[/url], or to eric@modernwolf.net.[/b]


[b]Options[/b]
"[b]-log_to_file[/b]": Writes debug log information to a text file found in %LOCALAPPDATA%\ZERO_Sievert\ (e.g C:\Users\YourUserName\AppData\Local\ZERO_Sievert) and is named with a timestamp, like 2023-7-20_10-58-31.log
"[b]-strict_cloud[/b]": Adds extra behaviour checks for Steam Cloud issues.

[h3]How to Add Launch Options[/h3]
[list]
[*] Right-click on ZERO Sievert in your Steam library.
[*] Choose properties.
[*] Under the general tab, input "-log_to_file" AND "-strict_cloud", without the quotation marks, into the "Launch Options" text box. It should look like the below screenshot:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/e5a815a7856db8c0a52d47fc3afcf6863274d380.png[/img]
[*] Close the properties tab and launch the game; the game will generate a pop-up window to let you know the above two launch options are enabled, like below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/4278a75e640974311160531f7999fa3d8d0e1043.png[/img]
[*] You can then find the log stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\ZERO_Sievert\ (e.g C:\Users\YourUserName\AppData\Local\ZERO_Sievert) and send it to us.
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/92d49f63f2a9595e30206314af258a413bc527fa.png[/img]

Hunters,

As we've promised, and with our heartfelt gratitude for your patience and invaluable feedback, we're rolling out another hotfix! The patch notes for Hotfix 0.31.20 are as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/6c72d9790e1bd9245df35d22f47ba5cdbb88f56c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where the game crashed when firing a weapon with certain suppressors attached.
[*] Fixed a gameplay issue that prevented the completion of the "Soldier work 2" quest.
[*] Fixed bugs preventing the completion of “Ride the Outpost“ and "Eliminate the Assassins" quests.
[*] Corrected an issue where "I've helped you dock" from Crimson Corp can be triggered multiple times.
[*] Fixed a problem where Daily Retrieval Quests items did not count towards the intended quest completion.[b]*[/b]
[*] Resolved an issue where the "Retrieve the Analyzer" task could not be completed if active on 2 different maps.[b]*[/b]
[*] Addressed an issue where saves were not deleted upon using ALT+F4 on the death screen in permadeath mode.
[*] Corrected an inventory corruption issue occurring after using ALT+TAB multiple times.
[*] Fixed a bug where inventory items disappeared after using ALT+TAB multiple times.
[*] Resolved a problem where quest items are stacked in the user inventory even if the items aren’t stackable.
[*] Fixed a bug where disassembled weapons could be found in NPC's corpses.
[*] Fixed a bug where disassembled weapons could be found in Weapon Boxes.
[*] Fixed a bug where Mr. Junk's and Igor's quests could not be completed if the player handed in the quest but died before extraction during the same raid.
[*] Corrected a gameplay issue where users cannot be killed by anomalies while having an infirmary module installed.
[*] Resolved a bug where traders' money resets to 15,000 Roubles at 7AM regardless of the difficulty slider settings.
[*] Addressed a description error for "Laboratory Main Room Key".
[*] Resolved a graphics issue where Fog of War gets drawn at full extent of scoped view.

[b]*[/b]For these quests, if they're already in your list, the fix won't work. Unfortunately, you'll need to abandon and re-accept these quests for proper functioning.

[b]Known and investigating[/b]: Missing quest markers for Crimson work 1 and 2 quests.

We can't overstate how much we appreciate your ongoing support, feedback, and bug reports. Your contributions are key in helping us consistently improve and fine-tune ZERO Sievert.

Here's to safe and successful hunts!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.31.15 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/92d49f63f2a9595e30206314af258a413bc527fa.png[/img]

Hunters!

Your unwavering support, invaluable feedback, and detailed bug reports are deeply appreciated! Thanks to your continued assistance, we've been able to pinpoint and address several key issues. Here are the patch notes for [b]Hotfix 0.31.16, which is now live[/b]!
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would crash when clicking "Repair Gear" from the crafting station. 
[*] Fixed a bug where the silencer of all guns wouldn't produce sound. 
[*] Fixed a bug where difficulty settings would change for the previous save when creating a new one. 
[*] Fixed a bug preventing looted weapons from being modded. 
[*] Fixed a bug where removing attachments from the crafting station would duplicate them. 
[*] Fixed a bug where stash items wouldn't count for quests and crafting station requirements. 
[*] Fixed a bug where the equipped armour would become invisible after closing the trade menu. 
[*] Fixed a bug where new saves would have the same skill level as previous saves. 
[*] Fixed a bug where disassembled weapons could be found in NPC's corpses. 
[*] Fixed a bug where new saves would have the same installed modules as previous saves. 
[*] Fixed a bug where installed modules wouldn't provide any items when being looted. 
[*] Fixed a bug where the reputation with Green Army or CC would drop to 0 when deploying on any map. 
[*] Fixed a bug where certain weapon mods were being attached by default but not reattachable.
[*] Fixed a bug where the backpack carry weight was sometimes calculated incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a bug where grass was not being drawn all the way to the edge of the screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where NPC names were being displayed when discarding items onto the ground.
[*] Fixed a bug where the skill level would reset after pressing ESC.
[/list]
[h2]New feature for future bug Investigation[/h2]

To aid us in further improving the game and fixing bugs in the future, we've added a new feature: launch options. When we are having difficulties reproducing a bug you have reported, we may reach out and ask you to provide us a log file generated this way, we thank you in advance, hunters.

-log_to_file: This option will write a lot of debug log information to a text file on disk. This text file is found in %LOCALAPPDATA%\ZERO_Sievert\ (e.g C:\Users\YourUserName\AppData\Local\ZERO_Sievert) and is named with a timestamp, like 2023-7-20_10-58-31.log. We can use information in this file to help us diagnose many problems.

-strict_cloud: This option will add extra behaviour checks. If anything goes wrong whilst initialising Steam or when writing to Steam Cloud then you will get a pop-up message.

[h3]How to add launch options[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Right-click on ZERO Sievert in your Steam library 
[*] Choose properties
[*] Under the general tab, input -log_to_file or -strict_cloud into the text box of "Launch Options"
[/olist]
Looking forward, we're working diligently on [b]another hotfix that will deliver more fixes next week[/b]. If you're still experiencing issues, please continue to let us know. Your input is crucial for improving ZERO Sievert.

Again, a big thank you to all of you for your patience, feedback, and bug reports. We're committed to making ZERO Sievert the best game it can be!

notes.title: Update 0.31 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/92d49f63f2a9595e30206314af258a413bc527fa.png[/img]

[quote] Hunters, 

Thank you for your patience and understanding in the leadup to this patch. Update 0.31 not only brings exciting enhancements to ZERO Sievert, but it also lays the groundwork for more thrilling updates in the future. In this patch we are excited to bring you deeper connections to the in-game factions. Choose your allegiance wisely - will it be the formidable Green Army or the lucrative Crimson Corporation? Discover new quests, daily challenges and more! 

As previously discussed in our dev blogs, this patch comes with a save wipe. To go alongside the save wipe, we've introduced a new save file system and numerous quality of life (QoL) improvements. We understand some players may wish to continue their journeys on their old saves, for those players, we're launching the Legacy branch today, which you can easily access from your library.  

We hope you enjoy this patch, and as always, let us know all your feedback on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sievert]Discord[/url] channel (or here!).

[b]Happy hunting![/b][/quote] 
[previewyoutube=fkuZecLI_tI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Major Update 0.31 Patchnotes[/h1]

[h2]Save Wipe[/h2]

[i]A new game is required for this build. The content of old save files will *not* be migrated to the new save file format.[/i]

However, if you wish to continue your current life in Zakov, you can select the legacy build (0.30) from the Beta tab. Here are the detailed steps to do so:
[list]
[*] Right Click on ZERO Sievert in your Steam library.
[*] Choose "Properties".
[*] Select "Betas" tab.
[*] Choose "Legacy - Build 0.30" from the dropdown menu.
[*] Your game should auto update to previous version for you to continue your old save.
[/list]
[h2]Modding[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Mod.ini file is no longer supported due to changes in the way weapons and items are stored in the backend, and that we have implemented a more powerful replacement.
[quote][i][b]Dev notes to modders:[/b][/i] 
[b]Changing Existing Data[/b]
Mod.ini is no longer supported in ZERO Sievert. Instead, we've implemented a powerful replacement! Most of ZS's game data is now stored in external JSON files, instead of being concealed within the game's code. This gives you the opportunity to adjust many different variables and values that were previously inaccessible. Not only can you alter weapon names, but you can also adjust their damage, bullet speed, magazine capacity, and almost everything else. JSON files are essentially text files that store data in a specific format, which can be edited with any text editor. However, you may need to tell your OS to open the .json file extension with a suitable program. JSON can be a bit fussy, so make sure you validate your JSON after editing, using an online tool, and always save in UTF-8 encoding.

You can find the new database files in the game's install directory (via Steam, right-click on ZERO Sievert in your library, then select "Manage" then "Browse Local Files"). The game's base data can be found in the /ZS_vanilla/gamedata directory. There, you'll find many JSON files, covering everything from ammunition to weapon mods, to chest loot tables, to NPCs. Feel free to modify these files as you wish. For example, if we wanted to rename the Nozin Makant to the solemn and respectful "Igor4eva," we would simply open up weapon.json, search for "Nozin Makant," change the name, and save the text editor. Upon running the game, the new game data is loaded, and the Nozin's name will be different. If you wish to truly honor Igor's memory, you might want to boost the Nozin's damage - though tread carefully because this change will also affect enemies. Unfortunately, you can't change game data while the game is running, so make sure to check your work before launching the game!

[b]Creating Something New[/b]
If you're looking to add something entirely new to the game, inserting it into the existing JSON files might be a bit challenging. You might have noticed a JSON file called gamedata_order.json in the install directory (and in the "ZS_vanilla" directory too). This file controls the location of JSON files and the order they are loaded into the game. Usually, gamedata_order.json uses relative paths. If you wish to add a new model of the BB 19 MOOSE, let's say a .45 ACP variant, you can create a new JSON file with only that item and then point to that JSON by adding a new file path to gamedata_order.json in the install directory.

[b]Extra notes and limitations[/b]
Please be aware that if you modify files inside the Steam directory, they will fail Steam's file integrity check, and your modifications may be lost upon reinstalling. To avoid this, we've made it possible to store mod files elsewhere on your computer to prevent them from being overwritten. As mentioned, gamedata_order.json usually uses a relative path to find JSON files, but it can also accept an absolute path. We highly recommend storing your mod files in a static location on your hard drive to prevent accidental loss.

There are a few limitations currently, however. NPC behavior and quest logic are not exposed, and many internal strings in the game are not available for editing either. At the moment, it's also not possible to change item or bullet graphics, which we know is a feature many of you are eagerly waiting for. Implementing dynamic graphics, audio, and logic into our engine in an efficient manner is a complex task that we don't want to rush.

That's all from us for now. Over to you! We hope you enjoy experimenting with the core mechanics of ZERO Sievert![/quote] 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/8bf329f92c5c084bbd28c5046ed712b9b6e4813a.png[/img]
[h2]Cloud Save[/h2]
Cloud save is now enabled for ZERO Sievert, which means you can now sync your save data across multiple platforms. [b]However, please note[/b] that if you are in the middle of a raid on one platform and start another session on a second platform, your raid progress won't be saved, as there are no saves or checkpoints mid-raid.
[list]
[*] Cloud Save feature now added to the game.
[*] An option to DELETE CLOUD SAVES is now available in the settings. [b]Please use this function with caution[/b], as it will permanently delete all your save files, as indicated by its title.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/168955f7471e2446ac4282209b4901a9b4ef21bf.png[/img]
[h2]Faction Relations & New Questline[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now join the Green Army or the Crimson Corporation once you grow your reputation among the factions.
[*] Completing main quests and daily quests will increase the reputation with that faction.
[*] Daily quests given by the Networker NPC are now separated based on the different factions.
[*] Added new quests and tweaks to existing quest.
[*] Items sold by the trader of a faction now require a minimum amount of reputation with that faction to be bought.
[*] Members of either the Green Army or Crimson Corporation will have access to exclusive quests as part of the chosen faction.
[*] Each faction will have their own daily quest, including Loner and Scientist factions.
[*] You will lose reputation with a faction in two ways:
[i]- When you shoot the first bullet to an NPC of a faction
- When you actually kills an NPC[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/a7859b4ddb0a34ddbc107b68ca79b90b6da57a97.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The game will now pause automatically when the window loses focus.
[/list]
[h2]Performance Improvement[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved loading times in game.
[*] Multiple memory leaks sealed up.
[*] Total memory usage significantly reduced.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/6c72d9790e1bd9245df35d22f47ba5cdbb88f56c.png[/img]

[*] Fixed an issue causing FPS drop when passing through gas on Low-Spec Machine.

[*] Fixed an issue causing corrupted behavior when the game window was being dragged using a laptop trackpad.
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur after placing a scrap weapon/material in the weapon slot and attempting to travel on any map.
[*] Fixed a bug where creating a new save using “Equipment 5” wouldn't give 0 Roubles.
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur after pressing "O" in the Bunker.
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur while standing in a high radiation level zone on the Makeshift Camp.
[*] Fixed an issue where only one Extraction Point was sometimes present on the Industrial Area Map.
[*] Fixed an issue where a "Task" menu placeholder was present on multiple NPCs when being interacted with.
[*] Fixed a bug where in-game days were not progressing after time passed 00:00.

[*] Fixed an issue where traders' inventories did not refresh after 7:30AM.

notes.title: Developer Update 2023 Vol.6 - All Aboard for Patch 0.31
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/3c13f18a1e5e1e3b08a82fb2d6733c33a589e9fc.png[/img]

Hello, Hunters!

It's time to hop on the train for another exciting update journey with the upcoming release of Patch 0.31 for ZERO Sievert. So grab your gear, and let's dive into the details of [b]what's coming next Wednesday.[/b]

[h2]Faction Relations, Quests and Reputation - The Ticket to Success[/h2]

First stop - faction relations and quests. After completing initial tasks for the barman, you'll unlock quests for the Green Army and Crimson Corp. Then comes the pivotal decision: which track will you take? You boost your reputation with a specific faction by fulfilling the bids of that faction through either main or daily quests. This increased reputation unlocks new gears from the faction quartermaster and presents the opportunity to join their ranks, as rewards for your dedication. Conversely, firing at an NPC will tarnish your reputation with the faction that NPC belongs to, and killing one will cause even graver consequences. So, aim wisely! Check out the screenshot below - it's one of our dev's choices... No judgement, please!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/302b9d3a87084c0e42775e0198533ae3fdd2d960.png[/img]

Faction leaders serve as your main contact within each group. You'll already be familiar with the leaders of the two primary factions, Green and Red. For the Loners and Scientists, the barman and the doctor take the lead, respectively. However, the daily tasks come not directly from these leaders but from the Networker, an independent entity orchestrating the operations. Each faction provides a unique set of tasks, like the Scientists' distinct quests for collecting crystals or analysing anomalies.

Life in Zakov is always hanging by a thread, and your choices truly matter. Joining the Green Army grants access to formidable equipment, but at the cost of making a permanent enemy of the Crimson Corp. Remaining neutral allows you to unlock a variety of gear from both sides, but the highest-end items remain elusive. It's a delicate balance to strike - so choose your path wisely.

[h2]Performance Improvement[/h2]

We're also thrilled to share that we've implemented some significant memory usage improvements in Patch 0.31 for ZERO Sievert. We've sealed multiple memory leaks and significantly reduced total memory usage, enhancing game performance and stability. This progress is key to ensuring a seamless gaming experience for all our Hunters. We thank you for your feedback, which continues to drive our development efforts.

[h2]Save Wipe and Legacy Build[/h2]

As we've mentioned in our previous dev blogs, a save wipe is coming with the new patch. But don't fret – if you wish to continue your current journey, you can select the legacy build (0.30) from the Beta tab. Here are the detailed steps to do so:

[list]
[*] Right Click on ZERO Sievert in your Steam library.
[*] Choose "Properties".
[*] Select "Betas" tab.
[*] Choose "Legacy - Build 0.30" from the dropdown menu.
[*] You game should auto update to previous version for you to continue your old save.
[/list]
[h2]Catch Up with Luca[/h2]

Did you catch our recent 'Behind the Scenes' session? Our very own Luca took centre stage to reveal the new features in Patch 0.31. If you haven't seen it yet, it's well worth a watch. You'll hear directly from Luca as he illuminates the upcoming changes. Don't miss out on this opportunity to get the inside scoop directly from the development floor!

[previewyoutube=Vnr2HsDB3s8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Preview Streaming[/h2]

If you're curious to see what's coming in patch 0.31, we invite you to join us on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/modernw0lf]Twitch[/url] channel on Monday the 17th at 4pm BST for an exclusive sneak peek of the new content. And remember, our dedicated Modern Wolf content creators are also preparing to share fresh and engaging content. So keep an eye out, you wouldn't want to miss their updates. 

[h2]Your Feedback Matters[/h2]

And finally, Hunters, as always, we're eager to hear your feedback on this update. Your thoughts and experiences fuel our work, so don't hesitate to share them with us.

So there you have it - the road ahead for ZERO Sievert. Thanks for being on this journey with us, Hunters!

Onward and upward! We look forward to seeing you in Zakov!

☣️ Join the community on [url=https://t.co/bPaW7oUElW]Discord[/url]
☣️ Subscribe to our [url=http://eepurl.com/hWuO85]Newsletter[/url]

notes.title: Developer Update 2023 Vol.4 & Roadmap Update
notes.content:
[quote][i]In the heart of Zakov, where Hunters brave the fray,
Echoes of resilience, in the ruins' array.
An invitation calls, a tale yet to convey,
Join us in our Discord event, [url=https://discord.com/channels/796723961975013386/1027148595633340476]right this way[/url].[/i]

For those unaware, we are hosting a 'Poems of Zakov' competition on our Discord server, with a chance to have your poem featured in the game!
[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/3c13f18a1e5e1e3b08a82fb2d6733c33a589e9fc.png[/img]

Hunters,

Welcome to our latest dev blog. A month has slipped by since we released patch 0.30, and we trust you've been making the most of it in the harsh, unforgiving wastes of Zakov. Rest assured, we've been far from idle, working tirelessly behind the scenes to bring you more exciting experiences.

Recently, we all had a fantastic time at our company's quarterly meeting in London. The laughs, the brainstorming, the lively discussions – we enjoyed every moment. Sharing such camaraderie, we are more inspired than ever to deliver the best for ZERO Sievert.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/b5de8fc8947577084c156263dffe04247c133cfa.png[/img]

Let's now turn to the crux of this blog post. Our energy and dedication are currently channelled towards [b]introducing fresh quests, refining existing ones[/b], and ushering in the long-awaited [b]faction relations[/b] feature in the forthcoming patch 0.31. These enhancements are pivotal, but there's more. We're also carving out the [b]foundation for something phenomenal[/b], a feature that we can't reveal just yet, but can assure you that it's going to be worth the wait.

However, to make this leap, to truly elevate the world of Zakov, [b]we need to carry out a save wipe in the next update[/b]. We understand that a save wipe might seem a bit unsettling, but it's a necessary step and a step forward for ZERO Sievert to grow and evolve. We appreciate your understanding as we make these necessary adjustments. 
[b]*For those of you who want to keep your current progress, we will provide an option to stay on a beta branch for the old build.[/b]

We apologise for any inconvenience this may cause, but we firmly believe that these updates will make your journey in Zakov even more thrilling. We are excited for you to experience these new features and enhancements.

[b]The patch 0.31 is expected to drop at the end of June or early July.[/b] We will share more details on the patch in our next dev blog in the coming weeks. In the meantime, we are thrilled to present the latest update to ZERO Sievert roadmap. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/577b870d734cf81873383f0e0b4bec036a0a22ec.png[/img]
[quote][i]To all you brave hunters in Zakov,
Your patience and dedication, we do laud.
As for the future, keep your eyes on the track,
Exciting times are coming, that's our pact.[/i]

Stay tuned, Hunters, and as always, stay safe in the wastelands!
[/quote]

notes.title: Update 0.30 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
[quote][b]Hunters, 

First of all, we'd like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all the players who have taken the time to test our opt-in beta branch. Your dedication and invaluable feedback have been instrumental in helping us identify and address various issues, ultimately leading to a more polished and enjoyable gaming experience for everyone. Thank you for being an essential part of our community and for contributing to the ongoing success of the game.

Update 0.30 brings daily quests, new guns, new attachments, many QoL improvements, as well as over 50 bug fixes into the game! Hope you enjoy it, and as always, let us know all your feedback on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sievert]Discord[/url] channel (or here!).

Happy hunting![/b][/quote]

[previewyoutube=QeLff4Eu2eQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Major Update 0.30 Patchnotes[/h1]
[i]Current savegame compatibility: compatible[/i]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h3]Daily Quests[/h3]
Introducing Daily Quests to ZERO Sievert! We're excited to announce that we've just added a brand-new feature to enhance your adventures in the world of Zakov. Starting today, you'll find Daily Quests waiting for you in-game, which refresh every day at 7 AM Zakov time. These quests are designed to offer you a variety of challenges tailored to different difficulty levels, ensuring that there's something for everyone. The best part? There's no deadline to complete them, and you can always give up a quest through the quest list if it's not to your liking. Get ready to embark on fresh, engaging missions every day and uncover even more of what Zakov has to offer!

[h3]New Guns[/h3]
[list]
[*] PP-19 Bizon

[list]
[*]9x18mm variant
[*]9x19mm variant
[/list]
[*]Tokarev TT-33
[/list]
[h3]New Attachments[/h3]
[list]
[*] AK Wooden foregrip
[*] Ak wooden foregrip with rail
[*] G36 desert attachments: stock and 2 handguards
[*] 2 Muzzle brakes for 9x18mm and 9x19mm
[*] 2 new long-range scopes
[*] 7.62x25mm silencer
[*] 12x70mm silencer
[*] 7.62x51 30 rounds and 50 rounds magazine
[/list]
[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Marginally improved map generation times and in-game performance on maps with lots of grass.
[*] Fixed a memory leak issue.
[*] Improved stability and performance, especially on low-spec hardware.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] The map seeds will now be shown when in debug mode.
[*] Updated intro animation.
[*] Removed version update message on first boot.
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life & Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a “Resume” button to the main menu that will load the last played slot.
[*] You can now remove certain quests from your quest list.
[*] Extraction zones now have a green flare as an indicator.
[*] A red HUD appears at the screen border when the user is hit while scoping.
[*] A dedicated keybind has been added to unjam a weapon (default: "V").
[*] Weapons now remember the last selected fire mode.
[*] Hovering over a weapon now displays compatible ammo and vice versa.
[*] Boars now make almost constant sounds when attacking.
[*] Sleep will now cure all bleeding stacks.
[*] Sleep will cure radiation at a rate of 0.01 radiation per minute (in-game time) of sleep.
[*] No matter the value of the setting "amount of single item," items found in containers that have their maximum stack amount equal to 1 cannot exceed this amount.
[*] The quantity of a single item in both containers and traders cannot exceed 999.
[*] Injectors now have new names.
[*] In-game year/day/month now reflects real world dates. (No more February 30)
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly decreased stamina regeneration.
[*] Sprinter skill sprint speed nerfed: from 10% + 3% per level to 5% + 1% per level.
[*] Scrap material needed to repair equipment is slightly increased.
[*] Armour repair from the doctor is now calculated based on the price of the armour, not its armour class. Generally, armor repair is more expensive now.
[*] Increased price for injectors.
[*] Small rebalance for injectors.
[*] Small balance changes made for consumables:

[list]
[*] Cooked meat: Hunger 23 -> 16
[*] Sandwich meat: Hunger 16 -> 22
[*] Bottle of water: Thirst 20 -> 25
[*] Rotten water: Thirst 18 -> 12. Radiation 0.3 -> 0.4
[*] Cooked pasta now gives 2 bowls instead of 1.
[*] Cooked egg no longer requires water.
[*] Sandwich butter now requires only 1 bread.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies can spawn in walls.
[*] Fixed a bug where there are unreachable extraction points on any map.
[*] Fixed an issue regarding shadow casting in the bunker.
[*] Fixed an issue where the "tutorial" tab is highlighted after the user returns from the "Data" menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where a tank is floating in the northern area of the Bunker.
[*] Fog Alpha can no longer be adjusted, even if Fog of War is set OFF.

Updated intro animation.

Increased price for injectors.
Small rebalance for injectors.

Bottle of water: Thirst 20 -> 25
Rotten water: Thirst 18 -> 12. Radiation 0.3 -> 0.4
Cooked pasta now gives 2 bowls instead of 1.
Cooked egg no longer requires water.
Sandwich butter now requires only 1 bread.

notes.title: Developer Update 2023 Vol.3
notes.content:
[h2]Developer Update for ZERO Sievert: All Aboard for a Bright Future, Hunters![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/3c13f18a1e5e1e3b08a82fb2d6733c33a589e9fc.png[/img]

Greetings, Hunters!

We're eager to share some crucial updates with you on the development of ZERO Sievert. We hope you've been enjoying the recent update, which introduced difficulty customisation. Now, we're stoking the engine to bring you an even more outstanding gaming experience that's bound to keep you on your toes. So, let's dive right in!

[h2]Team and Development Update[/h2]

[h3]Collaborating with a GameMaker Expert: Enhancing Our Team[/h3]
As a result of ZERO Sievert's Early Access launch success and your unwavering support, we're excited to welcome a GameMaker expert, Juju, to collaborate with Luca, who has been working tirelessly to bring you the best gaming experience. Together, they'll combine their strengths to unlock the game's full potential and create something truly exceptional for our community. This collaboration is all about teamwork and synergy, with both developers bringing their unique talents to the table. Luca 's outstanding vision and efforts have laid a solid foundation for the game, and the addition of Juju will only enhance and elevate the amazing work they've already accomplished.

[h3]Rethinking Patch Release Cadence[/h3]
We've been giving our patch release schedule some serious thought. While we previously adhered to a monthly release schedule for major updates, we're changing our approach to focus on delivering more or bigger content with each patch, especially with Juju onboard now. This means updates may arrive less frequently, but rest assured, they'll be packed with even more excitement!


[h2]0.30 Content Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/0362fe96d98d14bfb35e838934610709a6ee9858.png[/img]

[h3]Daily Quests: Your New Favourite Pastime[/h3]
We've heard your requests, and we're excited to announce that daily quests will be introduced in the upcoming Update 0.30. You asked for more, and we're giving you a first-class ticket to endless fun and challenges!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/5a46d8f3b519fe5fca783c7de1b49bb6e24cc0ca.png[/img]

[h3]New Guns and Attachments to Discover[/h3]
Get ready to expand your arsenal in Update 0.30, which will introduce new guns and attachments. These additions will provide you with new options for conquering challenges and running through enemies (or you-know-who) like a steam-powered locomotive!

[h3]Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
No one enjoys encountering ghouls in walls or dealing with slow loading times, which is why Update 0.30 will bring numerous bug fixes and quality of life enhancements. To get a sneak peek of what's in store, check out the current live beta branch! Update 0.30 will bring you over 50 bug fixes!

[b]We would also like to give a BIG shoutout to anyone who have been helping us by opting in the beta branch and providing invaluable feedback! [/b]

[h2]Update 0.30 Launching Next Week & Preview Stream[/h2]

Mark your calendars, Hunters: Update 0.30 will be released next week! To give you a taste of what's coming, tune in to our update preview stream this Wednesday at 4:00 PM BST on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/modernw0lf]Twitch[/url] channel. You won't want to miss it! Be sure to keep an eye on your favourite ZERO Sievert content creators too, as they'll be producing an array of engaging new content to keep you entertained and informed.

[b]We're incredibly grateful for our devoted community of Hunters. Your support, feedback, and passion have fuelled ZERO Sievert's growth and continue to drive its evolution. We're always listening and eager to make the best possible ZERO Sievert based on your invaluable feedback.[/b]

Here's to a thrilling future together, Hunters. See you in the bunker!
