notes.title: Developer Update 2023 Vol.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/3c13f18a1e5e1e3b08a82fb2d6733c33a589e9fc.png[/img]

Hunters,

We hope you are enjoying the game so far and are satisfied with the recent addition of emissions and radioactive rain. 

Today, we would like to address an aspect of the game that has been a focal point for the community, both new and veteran hunters, since the game's early access launch: the difficulty of the game.

One of the biggest complaints from new players is that the game is too difficult, with enemies one-shotting them. While this level of difficulty is largely by design and intended to challenge players, we are aware that it may be discouraging for casual or new players. On the other hand, our veteran hunters crave a more hardcore experience, such as having all items lost upon death and having a permanent death mode, requests that we agree are fitting for the game. 

To address the needs of both parties, we are pleased to announce that we are introducing difficulty settings in the upcoming major update 0.29.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/k2v6k5n/ZS-Difficulty-Settings.gif[/img]

[h3]Difficulty Modes[/h3]

We have provided three pre-set difficulty modes for players who do not wish to adjust all the settings themselves. These settings are:

[b]Rookie[/b]
This setting is suitable for new players who are new to the genre or anyone who prefers a casual experience. In this difficulty, resources will be plentiful, enemies will deal less damage, and your character will be more durable.

[b]Survivor[/b]
This setting provides the intended ZERO Sievert experience, where the world is challenging but not unjust. Resources are limited, and players must plan their moves carefully. Enemies are more formidable, and players are more susceptible to damage.

[b]Hunter[/b]
As the title suggests, this mode is for hardcore hunters who value immersion above all else. In this mode, players will lose all items in their inventory upon death.

[h3]Difficulty Customisation Options[/h3]
For hunters who like to personalise their gaming experience, we have also provided individual sliders to modify almost all elements of the game. We welcome your [url=https://discord.com/channels/796723961975013386/1022505147332571186]feedback[/url] on the new settings, and if you encounter any new bugs, please report them in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/796723961975013386/1022504219644792852]bug report[/url] channel on our Discord server. 

[b]Trading[/b]
In this section, players can adjust multipliers for sell price, item price, vendor money, and more.

[b]Loot[/b]
This is where players can experiment with what they'll be able to find out in the wastes. You can set the drop rate, minimum/maximum weapon durability, determine if NPCs can drop armour, and more here.

[b]Progression[/b]
This section provides options for customising the progression of the game, including character HP, transportable weight, hunger and thirst decay rates, skill exp rate, rouble and quest item rewards, and service prices.

[b]Enemies[/b]
Dying too often or are you gunning down enemies too easily? Here is where players can adjust enemy HP and damage dealt.

[b]Hardcore[/b]
If players would like to change what items they lose upon death or try out a permadeath run, this will be where they'd find those changes.

*Note: Each save game has its own difficulty settings and they are not shared globally. Changing the difficulty settings will require you to start a new game, as the settings cannot be changed mid-game.

[h3]Other Features[/h3]
[b]Field of View (Under Graphic Settings)[/b]
This new addition to the game introduces the player field view, meaning that the map will only be visible to players in a limited, forward-facing angle, rather than a full 360 degree view.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/3RBsmw1/ZS-FOV.gif[/img]

[b]Teleportation (to NPC)[/b]
The bunker can be vast, so for convenience, we are offering bunker NPC teleportation services. Simply press 'H' and select the NPC you are eager to visit!

[b]Main Menu[/b]
Last but not least: We have reworked the main menu to provide a better experience, both in terms of visual appeal and functionality.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/xFmBBbj/ZS-Main-menu.gif[/img]

Goodbye for now, hunters! We look forward to next week's release of update 0.29 and hope the new difficulty settings bring lots of excitement for all players. Remember to tune in this Thursday at 4:00 PM GMT on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/modernw0lf]Twitch[/url] channel to get an early look at [strike]our Community Manager Lottie getting killed in Hardcore mode[/strike] the new features. Keep an eye on our content creators, too, as they'll be releasing content for the update soon. As always, we welcome your thoughts and opinions on how we can make the game the best it can be, if you have any feedback please do not hesitate to reach out in our [url=https://discord.com/channels/796723961975013386/1022505147332571186]feedback channel[/url]. 

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Update 0.28 | Patch Notes
notes.content:
Good day, hunters! 

Thank you for all your continued feedback on all channels, 0.28 update is now live. We hope you enjoy the update, and keep all the juicy feedback coming. We are working hard on the next update and will share more information with you via the next dev blog when we are closer to the next update, until then, happy hunting and dying!

V 0.28

[b][i]Current savegame compatibility: compatible[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/8bf329f92c5c084bbd28c5046ed712b9b6e4813a.png[/img]
[h3]New Features[/h3]

[b]Radioactive rain[/b]
[list]
[*] The whole map becomes radioactive based on rain intensity. During radioactive rain the usual “visual noise effect” for radiation is deactivated.
[/list]

[b]Emission[/b]
[list]
[*] Special weather event that creates a burst of radioactive waves. Players can stay behind certain covers to avoid damage. Human NPCs will try to flee. At the end of the emission a radioactive rain at max intensity will start, so you are warned, hunters. 
[/list]

[b]Keybinding overhaul[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now re-bind keys for all keys and mouse buttons.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/168955f7471e2446ac4282209b4901a9b4ef21bf.png[/img]
[h3]Gameplay Changes and Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Santa armour and weapon are removed from the crafting table, but lights can still be crafted.
[*] The user can pay the barman to refill hunger and thirst.
[*] Money spent for services provided by NPC (healing, repair etc.) are added to the global trader money in the bunker.
[*] Hovering over the weight indicator in the inventory shows a coloured overlay for each item based on its weight.
[*] Hovering over the roubles indicator in the inventory shows a coloured overlay for each item based on its value. (In Bunker only)
[*] Items needed for craft are now shown in green/red to indicator if the required number are met.
[*] Clicking on a recipe now shows the skill and module required.
[*] Looting interaction tooltip "Loot" will appear greyed-out if the user has already looted that container.
[*] Items will be centred to cursor position when players drag them.
[*] Detailed numbers on character stats (hunger, thirst, fatigue, radiation) when hovering the cursor over the UI will no longer show up if players hold the right mouse button to extend the aim. 
[*] Keys for “get out of a collision” prompt changed from arrow keys to WASD.
[/list]

[h3]New Settings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Setting: Option for sprint toggle.
[*] Setting: Skippable animation for consumable items. Works only in the bunker and only for “food” items.
[*] Setting: Players can select the time needed for the item HUD to show up when players hover the cursor over an item.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/6c72d9790e1bd9245df35d22f47ba5cdbb88f56c.png[/img]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Radiation will now save correctly when returning to the bunker.
[*] Fixed a bug where inventory cells were drawn red even if there was enough space when dragging a rotated item.
[*] Fixed a crash when selecting a module on player's device.
[*] Fixed a bug where players cannot consume an item located in the right part of the stash close to the margin.
[*] Fixed a bug where the nutritionist specialisation was not correctly increasing the total stamina.
[/list]

notes.title: Developer Update 2023 Vol.1
notes.content:
Hunters,

We hope you have all managed to survive so far in Zakov and had a good holiday in your bunker. We are back and bringing you the New Year Edition of the developer update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/1865b297124da97582aaa06905a5a622841d9778.png[/img]

As we mentioned in the previous  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1782120/view/3615857706248592068] blog[/url], Zakov is becoming an even more dangerous place as you'll now start to encounter emissions from time to time. The upcoming Update 0.28 will (radioactively) rain on you right next week! 

[h3]Upcoming Patch[/h3]
[b]Content Update 0.28 Preview - Live Next Week[/b]

[b]Game engine update[/b]
We've updated the game engine from Game Maker 2.2.5 to Game Maker LTS which enables further opportunities for us to make changes to the game in the future.

[b]Emission[/b]
Why are all the crows flying away? What is that sound from afar? Are you hallucinating?

[img]https://i.ibb.co/xsjGPhs/ZERO-Sievert-Emission-1.gif[/img]

[b]Radioactive Rain[/b]
Nowhere to run, nowhere to go, radioactive rain is down upon you!! Will you accept your death, or will you fight it?

[img]https://i.ibb.co/K08c5m6/ZERO-Sievert-Radioactive-Rain-1.gif[/img]

[b]QoL Improvement Highlights: [/b]
As always, we cannot express how much we appreciate everyone’s feedback, feel free to send us more in our [url=https://t.co/bPaW7oUElW]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/ZeroSievert]Twitter[/url] or elsewhere. You are helping us to make a better game for you!

[list]
[*] We heard you loud and clear, and we prioritised the key binding overhaul so more players could enjoy the game in their own settings. You can now rebind any actions to almost any keys on your keyboard and mouse!
[*] What is a barman if they can’t provide you food and drinks? Barman now can refill your hunger and thirst!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/2a91e5ae0e79bb81517f4063f773c0f8faacf337.png[/img]
[*] Where did all the money you spent on healing and repairing go? Is there any embezzlement involved? Not anymore! Money spent for healing and repair will increase the global trader owned currency.
[*] Drinking and eating in bunker is now instant.
[*] Looted containers now appear grey-out when looting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/804b7b804bc2544d034de13bc7b8ecf7d938d38a.png[/img]
[*] And a lot more!
[/list]

[h3]Luca Cornernera[/h3]

[b]Q: What will the game look like in 2023?[/b]
Luca: This is a very difficult question! We have features planned for almost all of 2023 so expect the game to change a lot during this period. I cannot share anything too specific right now, but we are eager to share more information with you when we can!

[b]Q: How was your holiday? Any good gifts?[/b]
Luca: My holiday was very good. Although I did nothing and just spent time with my family and friends. Easy question! My girlfriend gifted me this, it’s so cool!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/59687d87d54c5b6e5defd798fa495341bdc8bb37.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: We are in 2023 now, any new year resolutions?[/b]
Luca: Not really, I usually don’t plan any resolutions for new year 😀

[h3]Final Words[/h3]
Update 0.28 will go live on Steam [b]next week[/b]. If you want to take a sneak peek at what the new update has to offer, tune in this Thursday at 4PM GMT on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/modernw0lf]Twitch[/url] channel as we show off the new content. Also be sure to keep your eyes out for coverage from some of your favourite creators as certain influencers will be getting access over the weekend! 

We hope you continue to survive and contribute to making Zakov a better place, one way or another. We will see you next time!

notes.title: Developer Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/F3fVyj1/Hazmat-Dev-Update-Cover-Image-800x450.png[/img]

To our hunters, whether you’re a newbie fresh out the bunker or a veteran with a stash the size of a house, we thank you for putting your faith in ZERO Sievert and joining us on the hunt! You’ve helped us keep the community super friendly and helpful for everyone, nominated us for [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1782120/partnerevents/edit/3487503939266045974]Best Game you Suck at Awards[/url] on Steam and also made some amazing Igor faces in our [url=https://t.co/bPaW7oUElW]Discord![/url].  It’s only been a month since early access was released into the wasteland but 0.27 is just around the corner. We’ve already released patch 0.26.2 to address topline concerns and 0.27 is next week with major updates still in the pipeline.  

This is our first dev blog and we will be releasing one alongside every update! With this we can guide you on the ins and outs of the progress of ZERO Sievert and we're giving you a heads up on upcoming patches so you can get yourself geared up for the next hunt! 

[h3]Our Community[/h3]

The community has grown immensely with over 35K members in our [url=https://t.co/bPaW7oUElW]Discord![/url], Over 2.5K followers on our [url=https://mobile.twitter.com/zerosievert]Twitter[/url] and over 1000 [url=https://t.co/RTUC8NsFxK]Newsletter[/url] signups. We are listening to all your feedback as always and are reviewing everything but join us on any of these platforms to keep yourself up to date. 

We also have a stream coming up this thursday to show off the latest 0.27 patch and if you want to see it first hand you can join us over on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/modernw0lf]Twitch[/url]

[h3]Upcoming Patch[/h3]

[b]Patch 0.27 Preview - Coming Out Next Week[/b]

Check your craftables for some seasonal surprises;
Crimson Corporation will now feature in the bunker once you have completed certain quests;
New Boar attack (as if there weren't enough already?!);
You can now edit the names of the weapons in the file “Mod.ini”
Steam trading cards and badges!
And more!

[h3]Luca Cornernera (See what we did there?)[/h3]

Here we sit down with Luca himself, and hear what he has to say about the game, and about life.

[b]Q: How do you feel about the launch and the first big patch that is coming next week?[/b]
A: The launch went great! I never expected such a thing! Needless to say, we are all very happy. I really enjoy working on the whole process from just an idea for a feature through to its implementation. Next week players can look forward to a surprise for lovers of RGB lights and the addition of the first real choice the player will have to make that can permanently change a playthrough.

[b]Q: What are you currently working on and looking forward to?[/b]
A: Now that the new build is ready I'm testing it and looking through all the features suggested on Discord. I'm really just very excited to work on the game and continue to develop it!

[b]Q: Finally, what's your favourite food and drink?[/b]
A: MILK! All kidding aside, my favourite non-alcoholic drink is water and alcoholic drink would be beer. For food it's a real cliché - pizza and pasta! For pizza I have no particular preference while my favourite pasta is carbonara.

If you have any questions you would like to ask Luca for the next Luca Cornernera feel free to comment below, or reach out to us on [url=https://t.co/bPaW7oUElW]Discord![/url]

[h3]The future of ZERO Sievert - 0.28 and beyond[/h3]

A sneak peek into the next patch! This is of course subject to development changes, but we want to keep you in the loop as much as possible! This is what we can share with you at the moment, more will be revealed in the next developer update!

[h3]Next Major Patch - 0.28[/h3]

Introducing Radioactive Rain. No one will be singing in this rain!
Emission (blowout). Sounds familiar? It is exactly what you are thinking.

Good luck out there. You’re going to need it! See you in 2023 for our next Developer Update!

notes.title: Patch 0.26.2
notes.content:
Hello Hunters!

We've had overwhelmingly positive feedback from you all and thank you for all your amazing feedback! We really appreciate the time you have taken out to support us. Our first small patch, 0.26.2 is live now for ZERO Sievert. Stay tuned for future updates!

[list]
[*] Possible fix for the swamp generation bug
[*] Scrapping a stack of medication items will always provide at least the amount of the stack
[*] The keys for debug mode have been changed from F12 to CTRL + ALT + P
[*] Minimum selling value for equipment is 1, even if its durability is 0%
[*] Fixed a bug where repair eats resources but doesn't repair the equipment if the inventory is full
[*] Fixed a bug where repair eats resources but doesn't repair the equipment if the item is in stash 1
[*] Fixed a bug where the mouse disappears if the user opens the inventory while aiming with a scope
[*] Fixed a bug where it was always raining in the swamp ( It still rains a lot but less than before)
[*] Fixed the position of the shadow for the “infestation” enemy
[*] Fixed a bug where you can interact with a module and create the chest even if you don't have the module built
[*] Fixed some collision bugs in the mall map
[*] Fixed a bug where the mouse wasn't over the text in the "heal me" menu screen
[*] The red cross on the medication items has been changed to a green cross
[*] Fixed a bug where users could open their inventory during the sleep fade transition and duplicate their items
[/list]

We'd love to hear more from you in our active [url=https://discord.gg/Sievert]Discord community[/url]!

notes.title: A Hunter's Survival Guide
notes.content:
[u][h2]Survival Guide - Author unknown[/h2][/u]

[h3][b]You will die… A lot.[/b][/h3]
If you want to die less than usual (even though it’s pretty fun) here’s a survival book we found in the bunker when clearing out a hunter's stash. What happened to the hunter? That’s not important.

[b]Tip #1[/b]
Equip your gun and load them with ammo. Sounds silly? You'll be surprised.
Every time you respawn, reload the ammo. Moved on to a new area? You guessed it, reload the ammo. There is nothing worse than engaging in combat and you’re out of bullets, spending reload time being attacked!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/d463678a3c0ada1b89efd6a440fb6626df1e8275.png[/img]

[b]Tip #2[/b]
Believe it or not, not being greedy helps reduce the number of deaths. 
Do you really need that boar meat? Whenever you think “Just one more kill!”, “I can squeeze one more thing to my backpack”, shut that thought down and get to the extraction point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/cad16bed08bf08e35b770e97dbaa7ea1efb145a1.png[/img]

[b]Tip #3[/b]
Which brings me on to tip number 3. We ALL love to hoard, right? [b]WRONG![/b] Use those meds to heal up when you can. Keep an eye on those stats, don’t carry too much and be overweight and most importantly, survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/f966c49dd02611e23cf93be3988d397e75ac6a02.png[/img]

[b]Tip #4[/b]
Start off with smaller raids.
We’ve all run into raids in the past, getting shot one direction by numerous Bandits while getting chewed up by ghouls in the other, which usually means it’s game over. Settle for small raids, kill a couple of bandits, finish the good deed of the day and be done with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/af6fe0962728b1424e81d5c353f88e67cfa3ad62.png[/img]

[b]Tip #5[/b]
Whenever you enter a map the first thing you should do is to check where the extraction points are. This gives you a head start with which direction you should take in a short lived safe environment. If you right click on the map, you can even place a marker to where you need to go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/d107a1d57d32d83ed9af62ee3aedbad3d2423e57.png[/img]

[b]Tip #6[/b]
Sleep it off.
So, you don’t have a bed of your own? Share with one of your fellow hunters. Replenish and get back out there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/508b0f6ac803296d5bd724b07260146641486474.png[/img]

[b]Tip #7[/b]
The mouse wheel.
This one can be easily missed but use the mouse wheel for different options when you see the  popup tooltip.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/3ce3ee4e5736722b055cdbd95b16e58e321b8df4.png[/img]

[b]Tip #8[/b]
We mentioned ammo earlier but here’s a secret, there is ammo in enemy guns (I know, obvious!) unload the ammo once you’ve killed your enemy. Don’t waste those bullets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/1f42696544e20cf026de616f85a5b58e8cdaf9dc.png[/img]

[b]Tip #9[/b]
Make sure to look around your corners as your view is blocked by environmental obstacles. You never know where an enemy is hiding! And that’s the story of how I got a scar on my face.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/081dd44b6090760fec9b5ce61d9527b794203e38.png[/img]

[b]Tip #10[/b]
Enemy’s enemy is friend, or is it?
[i]*SPOILER ALERT* [/i]
Absolutely, not! Personally, I say if it moves, shoot it. Unless it’s Igor, I will leave that up to your conscience. However, if you do find an entire army that won’t shoot unless you shoot first it’s best to hold back. Tricky, but who says survival is easy, eh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41319473/62c1b885d4579ae6b4372ef9f548d673600d2fed.png[/img]

On that note, happy hunting folks!

[b]Check out the updated FAQs and known bugs below.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1782120/ZERO_Sievert/

[h3][u][b]Known issues & How to Work Around it[/b][/u][/h3]

Issue: Performance issues (low framerates) when ‘Fog of War’ is enabled.

Workaround: Make sure ‘Fog of War’ is disabled in your ‘Video Settings’
If you want to go a step further you can disable ‘Dynamic Grass’ but please note that the changes won't take effect until the next time the world is loaded in (train generation scene). We are aware of this issue and are working on a fix.

[h3][u][b]FAQ[/b][/u][/h3]

[b]What is ZERO Sievert?[/b]
Developed by CABO Studio, ZERO Sievert is a post-apocalyptic shooter inspired by S.T.A.L.K.E.R and Escape From Tarkov. This survival tense top-down shooter challenges you to scavenge the wasteland, take out bandits, and explore what’s left of this world.

[b]When will it be released?[/b]
The Early Access version of the game will launch later this year but the full game is planned to be released in 2023.

[b]Will there be a multiplayer option?[/b]
Currently we have no multiplayer plans - ZERO Sievert has been designed as a single-player experience but we are listening to all your feedback! 

[b]What platforms will Zero Sievert be released on?[/b]
At the moment, it will only be available for Windows. You can purchase your copy of ZERO Sievert on Steam when early access is released.

[b]What languages are available?[/b]
The Early Access game will be launched with English only, with German, Chinese and Korean localisation, among other languages incoming during EA.

[b]Can I carry on my demo save when early access is live?[/b]
Demo save games will not be compatible with the game when early access is available.

If you have any other questions, you can head over to[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1782120/discussions/0/] Steam discussions[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/KEb2t6s6bb]join our Discord[/url]! 
Our Veteran hunters would love to help!

notes.title: ZERO Sievert Early Access Arrives 22nd November!
notes.content:
We’re back with the news you’ve all been waiting for. We are excited to reveal the [b]Early Access release date for ZERO Sievert is 22nd November 2022[/b]! To celebrate we're giving you the latest demo available for 2 weeks running through the entirety of Next Fest and beyond! Use this time to get prepared for the apocalypse, explore the Forest and Industrial Areas, and complete over 25 quests as you get a full hands-on experience with the game.* 

[previewyoutube=RHgCBdtF-JI;full][/previewyoutube]
At launch in November you'll be able to raid 5 different procedurally-generated areas including the previously accessible [i]Forest[/i]; the [i]Industrial Area [/i]which is included in our current demo; and the new [i]Mall [/i]area that has all kinds of secrets, inside and out, waiting to be discovered. We can't wait for players to sink their teeth in and begin scavenging the wasteland!

Through the course of Early Access we have plans to introduce:
🌳 New areas to explore
💀 New enemies and bosses to defeat
🔫 New guns and attachments to discover and master

And MUCH more we're yet to discuss! We'd love for you to join us on this perilous journey, if you haven't already please consider [url=https://t.co/bPaW7oUElW]joining our Discord[/url] where we'd love to hear your ideas, feedback, and support! 

[h1]Latest patch includes:[/h1]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
- New Tutorial screens
- New weapons and attachments
- Mod weapons that are equipped or in your stash

[h3]Quality of Life Changes[/h3]
- Meds that stop bleeding interrupt bleed damage for the duration of the animation
- Trees will not fade if the player is in the inventory menu
- If you are indoor the prompt to exit now show "exit" instead of "enter"
- NVGs now works in the bunker
- Attachments will now highlight compatibility in the inventory 

[h3]Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Changes[/h3]
- Fixed the blank quest from the doctor
- Fixed the crash that can happen when you accept that quest
- Fixed a bug where you can't correctly repair your equipment
- Mod weapon menu now show the correct durability of weapons instead 100%
- Fixed a crash when Kibba was killed
- Fixed a crash during map generation if you have the "Mark a working truck" quest
- Minimap marker will now not be shown if the player is indoors
- Fixed a major memory leak that was causing the game to crash after a while
- Possible fix for the crash regarding shaders
- Fixed a bug where bleeding was not always stopped correctly (needs more testing)
- Fixed a bug where pressing space in "Press any key to continue" would also skip the train animation
- Fixed a bug where stamina was drained even if the player was running against a wall
- Fixed Steam shut down bug
- Fixed resolution bug with NVG
- Fixed a bug where clicking resume with an automatic weapons makes the player shoot
- Fixed a bug where sound don't pause correctly while entering the pause menu
- Fog of war optimization, with added setting for refresh rate
- Various small bug fixes

*Please note that Demo save files will not be transferrable to the full release - we're working on all kinds of improvements and changes between now and then! 

[b]When the odds are stacked against you, Can you do more than just survive?[/b]

notes.title: ZERO Sievert Gamescom Demo Now Live
notes.content:
We’re at Gamescom and Insomnia #69 this week to showcase ZERO Sievert and to celebrate we’re happy to announce the [b]demo is live[/b] once again for everyone to enjoy! 

This new demo is based off the latest build (0.23) and brings all kinds of changes we can't wait to get your thoughts on including:
[list]
[*]Reworked quests with multiple goals
[*]Tracked items will be highlighted when looting
[*]Player max HP reduced from 100 to 75
[*]Fatigue, hunger, and thirst values are now shown in the HUD if you hover over them with the mouse
[*]The train now leaves once you've been deployed
[*]New medical items such as sterilised bandages and injectors
[*]New rotten food that will restore less hunger and give a small bit of radiation
[*]And much, much more...
[/list] 
For the [u][b]next week only[/b][/u], you can explore the forest area from this post apocalyptic top-down extraction shooter and test your survival skills. If you have any feedback drop us a message on [url=https://discord.gg/5WeBBMFWPM]Discord[/url] or the discussions page and we'll get back to you soon!
